items.title: American steel — not overseas dumping — dominates Canadian imports, trade data shows
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Federal trade figures show American steel makes up more than half of Canada’s imports of galvanized and coated steel, complicating Cleveland-Cliffs’ argument that an influx of cheap overseas steel is ...
items.body: Federal trade figures show American steel makes up more than half of Canada’s imports of galvanized and coated steel, complicating Cleveland-Cliffs’ argument that an influx of cheap overseas steel is one of the top causes of Stelco layoffs. Global Affairs Canada steel import data shows that 54.1 per cent of the country’s 625,726 tonnes of galvanized and coated steel sheet imports during the first nine months of 2026 came from the United States. Stelco owner Cleveland-Cliffs has blamed the idling of its Hamilton, Ont., steel plant partly on what it describes as dumped overseas steel imports in Canada, arguing that Ottawa’s trade protections have failed to create a viable market for Canadian producers. Colin Mang, assistant professor of economics at McMaster University, says the claim that offshore steel is being dumped into Canada does not reflect the latest trade figures. He says much of the imported steel comes from the United States and that import prices of galvanized and coated steel have actually risen over the last several months. Still, Mang says Canada continues to import large quantities of steel even as domestic demand weakens, putting additional pressure on Canadian producers already struggling with declining exports to the United States. Cleveland-Cliffs CEO Lourenco Goncalves has argued that Canada’s galvanized steel market is too small to accommodate two domestic producers alongside what he called “an avalanche of imports.” In an Oct. 9 letter to Industry Minister Mélanie Joly, Stelco president and general counsel Paul Simon blamed the company’s difficulties in part on the “market-depressing impact of dumped, offshore imports” and U.S. tariffs. Simon acknowledged that Ottawa’s steel import restrictions, introduced in June 2025 and strengthened in December, had reduced some overseas imports. But he argued they had done little to protect the cold-rolled and coated steel products manufactured at Stelco’s Hamilton finishing operations. In response, Industry Minister Mélanie Joly pointed to federal measures restricting overseas steel imports in an Oct. 22 letter to Stelco, including tighter quotas introduced in December 2025. Imports from the United States and Mexico remain exempt from those restrictions. This report by The Canadian Press was first published Oct. 27, 2026. Brett Bundale, The Canadian Press

items.title: India's Bajaj Auto posts quarterly profit beat on healthy export demand
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Indian automaker Bajaj Auto posted a bigger-than-expected quarterly profit on Tuesday, helped by rising overseas demand and gains from favourable currency movements.
items.body:
Indian automaker Bajaj Auto (BAJA.NS) posted a bigger-than-expected quarterly profit on Tuesday, helped by rising overseas demand and gains from favourable currency movements.
The Pulsar-maker reported a 35.3% rise in second-quarter profit to 33.54 billion rupees ($352.55 million). Analysts, on average, had expected 31.68 billion rupees, according to data compiled by LSEG.
Demand in India's two-wheeler market remained strong in the July-September quarter as the tailwind from lower taxes from last year continued to benefit original equipment manufacturers, despite many manufacturers undertaking price hikes to offset rising costs.
However, domestic sales were significantly outpaced by export demand, with export volumes jumping 41%. This, along with favourable currency movements, also helped expand operating profit margins by 40 basis points.
Quarterly revenue from operations rose 34.1% to 200.03 billion rupees.
($1 = 95.1350 Indian rupees)

items.title: ＵＢＳ、外部ＡＩによる顧客代行の操作認めず＝ＣＥＯ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [チューリヒ ２７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[チューリヒ ２７日 ロイター] - スイスの金融大手ＵＢＳのセルジオ・エルモッティ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２７日、外部の人工知能（ＡＩ）モデルに顧客の代わりに行動させることは認めないと述べた。

銀行業界では、高度なＡＩエージェントが金融システムに悪影響を及ぼしかねないとの懸念が高まっている。関係者によると、米大手銀行は外部のＡＩエージェントによる顧客口座へのアクセスを遮断している。

エルモッティ氏は科学関連の会議で「最近、一部の銀行では、顧客口座の管理や預金の移動、最適化に当たってＡＩモデルが不適切に動作するリスクがあるという話を耳にしただろう。われわれはＡＩモデルが銀行にアクセスしてそうした操作を行うことを認めていない」と述べた。

ＡＩについて今最も重要なのは、判断の過程が見えないまま顧客に影響を及ぼすＡＩモデルを使わないようにすることだと語った。

また２０２３年に買収したクレディ・スイスとの統合に伴い、ＵＢＳはＡＩの導入ペースをやや落とさざるを得なかったが、現在は技術に一段と注力できるようになったと説明した。

「統合がほぼ完了したことをうれしく思う。これにより技術をどう活用して銀行の業務の実効性と効率を高めるかに、さらに力を入れられる」と述べた。

items.title: Hengrui Pharma reports 88.9% rise in 2026 third-quarter profit on licensing deals
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals , China's biggest drugmaker by market value, reported on Tuesday a rise of 88.9% in profit for the third quarter of 2026, driven by income from out-licensing deals.
items.body:
Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals (600276.SS) , China's biggest drugmaker by market value, reported on Tuesday a rise of 88.9% in profit for the third quarter of 2026, driven by income from out-licensing deals.
Net profit of 2.5 billion yuan ($375 million) for the quarter ended September 30 was up from 1.3 billion a [USN:L6N3W50I6 TEXT:"year ago"]
The figure beat one analyst's forecast of about 1.84 billion yuan in net income, LSEG data showed
Third-quarter operating revenue rose 21% to 9 billion yuan
Drugmakers in China are expanding licensing deals and developing new medicines as Beijing's centralised bulk buying programmes squeeze their revenue.
Global drugmakers are stepping up the search for China‑developed experimental medicines as they cut costs ahead of [USN:L4N3R61G6 TEXT:"patent expiries"].
Hengrui sells both generic medicines and those it has developed itself such as Hodgkin lymphoma drug AiRuiKa.
In August the company said it had completed 13 overseas business development deals since 2023.
In September Hengrui said Danish drugmaker Novo Nordisk (NOVOb.CO) would [USN:L6N45L099 TEXT:"pay"] up to $2.6 billion for the rights to an experimental weight-loss pill.
By the end of the first half of 2026, 10 of Hengrui's innovative medicines were in Phase I clinical development.
Hengrui reported the third quarter results after the market closed
Shares are down about 23% so far this year, underperforming a fall of 2% in the Hang Seng Biotech Index (.HSBIO)
In the first half of 2026, 17 of Hengrui's clinical programs had advanced to Phase III, including its experimental psoriasis drug RSS0393 and breast cancer drug HRS-8080, its interim report showed
Hengrui said innovative drug sales revenue growth improved in the third quarter, but it expected a gap to persist for the full year between growth and a target set at the start of the year

items.title: Privacy group files complaints against Scale AI over alleged worker surveillance
items.author: The Straits Times
items.summary: Trackers follow workers while they work, including recording keystrokes and mouse movements.
items.body:
Privacy group files complaints against Scale AI over alleged worker surveillance
Sign up now: Get ST's newsletters delivered to your inbox

European digital privacy advocacy group NOYB is asking regulators to fine Scale AI and examine how the platform assigns tasks.
PHOTO: REUTERS

Published   Oct 27, 2026, 05:56 PM

Updated   Oct 27, 2026, 05:58 PM

Set as preferred source

Listen
Summarise

Privacy group noyb filed five complaints against Scale AI in four EU countries over alleged illegal worker surveillance on Outlier, a platform used to create AI training data.
The complaints say up to 19 trackers recorded keystrokes and mouse movements, and workers faced repeated ID and face checks that may break EU biometric rules.
noyb wants fines and a review of task assignment. DiPLab also found bonuses and game-like rewards pushed workers to complete many tasks fast.

AI generated

European digital privacy advocacy group NOYB filed five complaints against Scale AI in France, Italy, the Netherlands and Austria on Oct 27 , alleging it illegally monitored freelance workers who produce training data for artificial intelligence models.
The complaints target Outlier, a platform it operates on which more than 900,000 freelancers perform various tasks that are recorded to create AI training data for clients such as Meta, OpenAI and Google. Meta owns 49% of Scale AI.
NOYB is asking regulators to fine Scale AI and examine how the platform assigns tasks.

“You don’t work when you want,” said Thomas Le Bonniec, who spent two years studying the platform for Paris-based research collective DiPLab. “You work when the platform wants you to and there are tasks available.”
Scale AI did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
The complaints seen by Reuters said up to 19 trackers follow workers while they work, including recording keystrokes and mouse movements every few seconds. An investigation by DiPLab found the resulting file could be rebuilt into a video that replays a work session from start to finish.

Workers must also submit identification documents and face video to identity verification firm Persona. The complaints said the checks were invasive, repeated without explanation, and broke European Union rules on biometric data.
Outlier also uses game-like mechanisms, and bonuses are a key part of its incentive system, DiPLab found.
Outlier offered bonuses of US$100 (S$128) to US$200 for completing 200 tasks in 24 hours, Le Bonniec said, citing interviews with workers during his investigation. Italy’s data protection authority fined delivery platform Glovo in 2021 over similar gamification, he added.

Four workers asked Outlier for copies of their data between December 2025 and May 2026. None received an answer, the complaints said. REUTERS

items.title: Indian court orders takedown of documentary on Adani, Modi
items.author: Arpan Chaturvedi
items.creator: Arpan Chaturvedi
items.summary: An Indian court has ordered the takedown of an online documentary posted by Hotmail co-founder Sabeer Bhatia accusing Prime Minister Narendra Modi and billionaire Gautam Adani of cronyism, after Adani Enterprises sued, calling it defamatory.
items.body:
An Indian court has ordered the takedown of an online documentary posted by Hotmail co-founder Sabeer Bhatia accusing Prime Minister Narendra Modi and billionaire Gautam Adani of cronyism, after Adani Enterprises sued, calling it defamatory.
Adani's flagship firm, Adani Enterprises, told the High Court in eastern city of Kolkata that the documentary, which garnered millions of views on social media in recent days, was riddled with false content and had prompted inquiries from some investors in the company, whom the court order did not name.
The documentary "is not a news report or an account of proceedings. It is a dramatised narrative," the court's takedown order for YouTube, X and Meta issued late on Monday said.
Adani Enterprises (ADEL.NS) , Modi's office and Bhatia did not respond to requests for comment, and neither did the social media companies.
Modi's opponents have often accused the prime minister of having close ties with Adani, saying the business tycoon has received favourable treatment over the years. The Indian government and the Adani group have repeatedly denied those allegations.
In its challenge, Adani Enterprises told the court that it does not seek to restrain constructive criticism of government policy or of business concentration, but Bhatia had suppressed material facts, according to the court order.
Bhatia, who is based in the US, wrote on his X account the lawsuit demands 500 million rupees ($5.25 million) in damages. In one X post, he wrote "Truth is on my side".
"I believe the documentary has rattled Adani Enterprises Limited and struck a nerve at the highest levels," he wrote.
Bhatia is the co-founder of once-popular email service Hotmail, which he sold to Microsoft in 1997.
ORDER TO TAKE DOWN In an interim order in force until January 31, 2027, the court ordered YouTube, X and Meta's Instagram to remove several posts of the 36-minute film, "The Friendship Files”. It also restrained Bhatia from disseminating the video.
Hearings in the case are likely to resume in January.
Ahead of the court challenge, police in the state of Maharashtra, which is led by Modi's ruling alliance, sent a takedown notice to Bhatia on October 19, saying the content "made serious unsubstantiated allegations".
Modi’s political opponents have repeatedly been sharing the documentary, saying it reflected similar allegations they had made about the two men.
The film used archival footage to trace the history of the relationship between Modi and Adani, starting in the western state of Gujarat, where both men come from.
It raised questions about Adani's winning bid for six airports in 2019 after a government rule change that critics say favoured his enterprise - allegations similar to those levelled by the opposition Congress party.
The Adani group has denied such allegations and the government says all regulations were complied with and there is no favouritism.
Earlier, regional opposition leader and Modi critic Raj Thackeray shared the documentary on his X account where it garnered 4.8 million views, but took it down saying he was doing it at the request of the Mumbai police commissioner.
Mahua Moitra, another political opponent of Modi and a lawmaker, posted the documentary on October 11, and said it was still online.
"I posted this on Oct 11th. It is still on my timeline so do watch it," she wrote on X on Monday night.
items.raw_description: An Indian court has ordered the takedown of an online documentary posted by Hotmail co-founder Sabeer Bhatia accusing Prime Minister Narendra Modi and billionaire Gautam Adani of cronyism, after Adani Enterprises sued, calling it defamatory.

items.title: World to add less clean energy capacity this year, renewables agency chief says
items.author: Sudarshan Varadhan
items.creator: Sudarshan Varadhan
items.summary: The world will add less clean energy capacity in 2026 for the first time in five years due to inadequate transmission networks and trade barriers, the chief of the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA) said.
items.body:
The world will add less clean energy capacity in 2026 for the first time in five years due to inadequate transmission networks and trade barriers, the chief of the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA) said.
Growth in solar and wind capacity has been accelerating every year since 2021, when the coronavirus pandemic disrupted global supply chains. Clean power installations including hydropower surged a record 692 gigawatts, or 15.5%, to 5,149 GW in 2025 — representing half the world's power capacity.
Governments have pledged to boost clean energy use to ensure reliable power supply and cut costs, particularly after the US-Israeli war with Iran choked energy supplies and inflated prices. But IRENA Director-General Francesco La Camera noted that there has been a slowdown in renewables deployment in China due to curtailment — or rejection of clean power when a grid hits its limits.
"The main cause of a lack of new record in additions this year is the mismatch between generation capacity and the capacity to distribute and transmit electricity," he told Reuters on the sidelines of the Singapore International Energy Week conference.
China, the world's biggest renewable energy producer, turned away enough clean energy to power Mexico for a year in the first half of 2026, while networks in nations such as Australia and Japan also failed to keep pace with a surging renewables buildout.
"The amount of the (capacity) increase in the other parts of the world this year, I don't think it will offset the slowing down in China," La Camera said. He declined to provide a numerical forecast for expected growth in clean energy additions this year.
Renewable energy additions are crucial to reducing global emissions, and the United Nations said in a report last week that "urgent and stringent" emission cuts were required to slow global warming.
items.raw_description: The world will add less clean energy capacity in 2026 for the first time in five years due to inadequate transmission networks and trade barriers, the chief of the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA) said.

items.title: US stock futures muted as oil holds near April highs ahead of Fed decision
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: US stock index futures were little changed on Tuesday as crude oil hovered near its highest in six weeks, while investor attention turned to a slate of key corporate earnings and the Federal Reserve's interest-rate decision this week.
items.body:
US stock index futures were little changed on Tuesday as crude oil hovered near its highest in six weeks, while investor attention turned to a slate of key corporate earnings and the Federal Reserve's interest-rate decision this week.
The Fed is widely expected to [USN:L6N46518P TEXT:"hold rates"] steady on Wednesday following an increase last month, though markets are pricing in at least two more hikes by mid-2027 as key inflation indicators remain elevated amid the ongoing US-Iran conflict.
"While we don't expect a rate move this week, we wouldn't be against a hike even though we're not convinced of its urgency," said John Velis, head of Americas Strategy at BNY.
"We think maintaining credibility is paramount for the Fed, and as (Fed Chair Kevin) Warsh likes to remind us, the inflation target has been exceeded for well over 60 straight months."
Crude oil prices were slightly higher on Tuesday after falling in the previous session, with Brent crude near its highest level since late April.
At 05:17 a.m. ET, Dow E-minis were up 70 points, or 0.14%, S&P 500 E-minis were up 3.75 points, or 0.05%, and Nasdaq 100 E-minis were up 2 points, or 0.01%.
Megacap and growth stocks were mixed. Tesla (TSLA.O) shares climbed close to 1% in premarket trading, after jumping more than 5% in the last session.
Meta Platforms (META.O) was flat after the company increased its largest-ever [USN:L3N46C0RT TEXT:"equity fundraising"] to $97.5 billion to fund AI expansion.
Whirlpool (WHR.N) dropped 8.8% after the home appliance maker [USN:L2N46C0YW TEXT:"reported"] a third-quarter loss and missed revenue estimates.
Coca-Cola (KO.N) , Boeing (BA.N) and PayPal (PYPL.O) are some of the major companies scheduled to report earnings before markets open on Tuesday.
Hyperscalers Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , Microsoft (MSFT.O) and Amazon.com (AMZN.O) are set to report later this week. Their results will be parsed for signs of whether the hefty AI investments are translating into growth.
Jefferies equity strategist Jane Gibbons said in a note that growth for 'Magnificent 7' names could trail the rest of the S&P 500. The brokerage sees earnings for the group of the biggest US tech stocks growing at 21% versus 32% for the rest for the benchmark.
The AI trade has come under pressure this month on growing concerns that debt-funded spending may become harder to justify in the face of rising borrowing costs.
Investor sentiment improved somewhat in the [USN:L4N469179 TEXT:"previous session"], however, after AI lab Anthropic [USN:L3N46C10M TEXT:"revealed its IPO filing"], taking a big step towards a potentially record-breaking listing even as it disclosed steep losses and security concerns.
The development had helped lift chip stocks (.SOX) after a bruising few weeks, along with other AI beneficiaries, including photonic product makers and neoclouds.
Separately, investors are looking ahead to the November 3 midterm elections, which will decide control of the US Congress.

items.title: Jordan says it killed more than 20 Islamic State militants in airstrikes on Syria
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Jordan killed more than 20 Islamic State militants in airstrikes on southern Syria on Monday evening following a deadly attack on a church in Jordan, Government Communication Minister Mohammed al-Momani said on Tuesday.
items.body:
Jordan killed more than 20 Islamic State militants in airstrikes on southern Syria on Monday evening following a deadly attack on a church in Jordan, Government Communication Minister Mohammed al-Momani said on Tuesday.
Syria said the Jordanian strikes had killed seven people, including three children and a woman.
Jordan regrets civilian casualties, Momani said in a post on X.
Jordan said on Monday its air force had struck what it described as [USN:L2N46C03X TEXT:"militant hideouts"] in southern Syria after determining that the suspects behind last week's church attack were linked to "terrorist groups" operating there.
Senior government security officials said on Monday that Jordanian security forces had arrested two brothers and their brother-in-law after a shootout over the church violence that killed nine people.
There has been no claim of responsibility by Islamic State.
The Jordanian armed forces said the operation was conducted in coordination with Damascus. Syria's government said the airstrikes were carried out without coordination with Damascus and that it had launched an investigation into the attacks.

items.title: Qatar extends force majeure on LNG cargoes to Italy's Edison until end-December
items.author: Francesca Landini, Gianluca Semeraro
items.creator: Francesca Landini, Gianluca Semeraro
items.summary: QatarEnergy will prolong its Iran war-related suspension of liquefied natural gas (LNG) deliveries to Edison until the end of December, the Italian utility said on Tuesday.
items.body:
QatarEnergy will prolong its Iran war-related suspension of liquefied natural gas (LNG) deliveries to Edison (EDNn.MI) until the end of December, the Italian utility said on Tuesday.
In a message on the platform of Italy's energy markets manager GME, Edison said QatarEnergy had notified the extension of force majeure on LNG deliveries from a previous [USN:L8N45K0HY TEXT:"early-December"] deadline.
A further three LNG cargoes that were intended for the Italian utility - one of Qatar's biggest customers in Europe - will be affected by the suspension, Edison said.
QatarEnergy first notified the cancellation of LNG deliveries in April, following trade disruptions and damages to its LNG plants in Qatar caused by the US-Israeli war on Iran , started in late February.
Edison holds a long-term contract with QatarEnergy for the supply of 6.4 billion cubic metres of natural gas per year to Italy, around 10% of the country's total consumption.
The contract, which has been in force since 2009, has a total duration of 25 years.

items.title: Football-Mbappé perd plusieurs partenaires chinois, accusé d'avoir heurté les sentiments nationaux
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Kylian Mbappé a été lâché par plusieurs entreprises chinoises après la polémique suscitée par ses propos présumés dans une vidéo où l'attaquant français semble plaisanter au sujet d'une image le confondant avec l'ancien dirigeant chinois Mao Zedong.
items.body:
Kylian Mbappé a été lâché par plusieurs entreprises chinoises après la polémique suscitée par ses propos présumés dans une vidéo où l'attaquant français semble plaisanter au sujet d'une image le confondant avec l'ancien dirigeant chinois Mao Zedong.
Dans une vidéo apparue en ligne lundi, on entend Kylian Mbappé expliquer que le "mème" - une image ou une vidéo, souvent parodique, reprise massivement sur internet - le plus drôle qu'il ait vu de lui-même était celui où son visage avait été greffé sur celui d'"un dictateur chinois".
Les fans ont multiplié les mèmes superposant le visage du Madrilène à ceux de dirigeants militaires et politiques, suggérant son supposé autoritarisme.
Reuters n'a pas été en mesure d'authentifier la vidéo.
Fondateur de la République populaire de Chine, Mao Zedong est perçu par nombre de Chinois comme le sauveur de la nation et les plaisanteries à son sujet sont considérées comme un tabou. Il est mort en 1976.
Dans un communiqué publié sur le réseau social chinois Weibo, Eastroc Beverage, qui utilisait l'image de Kylian Mbappé sur ses boissons, a déclaré s'opposer fermement à tout "comportement qui heurte les sentiments nationaux".
"À compter de ce jour, nous mettons fin à toute coopération avec Kylian Mbappé", a ajouté la marque.
Les représentants du champion du monde 2018 n'ont pas répondu dans l'immédiat aux sollicitations de Reuters.
Dans un entretien accordé le mois dernier à L'Équipe, le Tricolore avait estimé que si certains aspects de cette tendance relevaient du simple divertissement, les mèmes viraux le présentant en dictateur traduisaient "un manque de conscience politique et humaine chez les gens".
Les groupes laitiers Mengniu et Milkground ont eux aussi mis fin à leur partenariat avec l'attaquant français.
Interrogé sur l'affaire, un porte-parole du ministère chinois des Affaires étrangères a indiqué que les paroles et actes portant atteinte aux sentiments du peuple chinois "se heurteront naturellement à un rejet commun de l'ensemble de la société".
La télévision d'État chinoise a suspendu la diffusion de tous les matches et événements impliquant la Liga et Kylian Mbappé. Les publicités dans lesquelles apparaît le joueur ont également été retirées, a rapporté mardi The Paper, un média public chinois.
La Liga et le Real Madrid n'ont pas répondu dans l'immédiat à une demande de commentaire.

items.title: Netherlands won't join 2027 Eurovision Song Contest as Israel protest continues
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Netherlands will not participate in the 2027 Eurovision Song Contest as no broadcaster is willing to take responsibility for the Dutch entry due to concern over Israel's participation, broadcaster association NPO said on Tuesday.
items.body:
The Netherlands will not participate in the 2027 Eurovision Song Contest as no broadcaster is willing to take responsibility for the Dutch entry due to concern over Israel's participation, broadcaster association NPO said on Tuesday.
The NPO last month said it was confident the Netherlands [USN:L6N45F0PN TEXT:"would return"] to the contest next year, after a boycott of the 2026 edition, as it felt the European Broadcasting Union had responded to criticism by countries that had not participated in 2026.
But ultimately no Dutch broadcaster was willing to facilitate the Dutch bid.
Ireland, Iceland, Spain, Slovenia and the Netherlands all boycotted the contest in May in protest at the participation of Israel and its military offensive in Gaza.

items.title: China boycotts Kylian Mbappe after perceived insult to Mao Zedong
items.author: Bloomberg
items.summary: CCTV has reportedly removed advertisements featuring Mbappe, stopped airing soccer matches involving the Frenchman and deleted all posts related to him from its official Weibo account ...
items.body: French soccer star Kylian Mbappe is facing mounting backlash in China after comments perceived as insulting Mao Zedong, with state TV blocking his matches, social media freezing his accounts and a slew of companies dropping him as ambassador. CCTV has reportedly removed advertisements featuring Mbappe, stopped airing soccer matches involving the Frenchman and deleted all posts related to him from its official Weibo account. Chinese social media platform Xiaohongshu also froze the footballer’s account after controversy erupted over remarks he made while discussing an internet meme that appeared to depict Mao, modern China’s founding father.  Mbappe’s official accounts on Weibo and Xiaohongshu, which both have around 1 million followers, were marked with notices saying they had been muted for violating regulations.  During a press briefing, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said that any words or actions that offend the Chinese people will inevitably encounter widespread opposition from Chinese society. Consumer brands that hired Mbappe as ambassador — Eastroc Beverage Group Co. and China Mengniu Dairy Co. — saw their stock drop. Shares of Eastroc fell as much as 4.1% in Shanghai, while Mengniu was down around 3% in Hong Kong. Both companies said they are severing ties with him.  Swiss sneaker company On Holding AG also deleted all Mbappe-related posts on its Chinese social media account. The sportswear brand did not immediately respond to a request for comment on its plans regarding its recently signed 10-year partnership with the 2018 World Cup winner. In a video, the footballer was asked which internet meme featuring himself had made him laugh the most. He described one involving a video of a man he said he thought was “a Chinese dictator,” with his own face superimposed on the figure. Mbappe said he frequently used the meme with friends while gaming online, but didn’t identify the person in the meme.  Taiwanese media outlet ETtoday reported that the image depicted Mao. Images circulating online also appeared to show Mbappe’s face superimposed on Mao. Neither Eastroc or Mengniu specified what prompted their decisions or referred to Mao in their statements.  Memes about Mbappe being a dictator have circulated at least since the World Cup this summer. It’s a nickname he’s carried for months and people have superimposed his face on several historical figures, often in military garb.  The episode quickly triggered criticism from nationalist users on Chinese social media, with some accusing Mbappe of insulting China and calling for a boycott. Prominent soccer outlet Dongqiudi said it wouldn’t provide a translation of his remarks as they were “hurtful to China and the Chinese people.” It’s not the first time that online controversies over perceived slights have hurt sponsorships and business ties. The National Basketball Association has worked to rebuild its brand in mainland China after a years-long fallout triggered by a social-media post supporting Hong Kong protesters in 2019 from Daryl Morey, then general manager of the Houston Rockets. Foreign companies including Swedish retailer Hennes & Mauritz AB and sportswear giant Nike Inc. have also faced consumer boycotts over comments on Xinjiang.

items.title: ユーロ圏の住宅ローン需要、金利上昇で第3四半期に急減＝ＥＣＢ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [フランクフルト ２７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[フランクフルト ２７日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が２７日に発表した四半期ごとの「銀行貸出調査」によると、金利の上昇を受け、９月までの３カ月間でユーロ圏の住宅ローン需要が急減した。

銀行の差し引き２７％が、第３・四半期に住宅ローン需要が減少したと報告。金融機関の予想（マイナス１２％）や前四半期（マイナス１５％）よりも顕著な減少となった。

ＥＣＢは「金利の上昇が需要減少の主な要因であり、次いで消費者信頼感の低下や住宅市場の見通しの悪化が挙げられる」と述べた。

各行は企業向け融資や消費者クレジットについては融資基準を引き上げたものの、住宅ローンについては引き上げなかった。第４・四半期にはあらゆる種類の融資について基準を引き締める見通し。

財政問題を巡って債券市場が混乱しているフランスは、欧州の大国の中でこうした引き締めが最も顕著だった。

ＥＣＢは「リスク認識の高まりと銀行のリスク許容度の低下が、与信基準引き締めの主な要因であり続けた。一部の銀行は、地政学的な不確実性やエネルギー情勢の推移により、圧力が高まっていると報告している」と述べた。

items.title: Ações chinesas caem para menor cotação em 14 meses; ações do setor de tecnologia ampliam queda
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: As ações chinesas perderam os ganhos registrados no início do dia e fecharam nesta terça-feira em sua menor cotação em 14 meses, com os papéis do setor de tecnologia retomando a queda após uma breve alta impulsionada por uma melhora no ânimo dos investidores na região.
items.body:
As ações chinesas perderam os ganhos registrados no início do dia e fecharam nesta terça-feira em sua menor cotação em 14 meses, com os papéis do setor de tecnologia retomando a queda após uma breve alta impulsionada por uma melhora no ânimo dos investidores na região.
No fechamento, o índice de Xangai (.SSEC) teve queda de 1,3%, o nível mais baixo desde agosto de 2025. O índice CSI300 (.CSI300) , que reúne as maiores companhias listadas em Xangai e Shenzhen, também recuou 1,3%.
O índice Hang Seng (.HSI) , de Hong Kong, caiu 0,7%, e o índice Hang Seng de Tecnologia (.HSTECH) recuou 1,5%.
O Índice Composto ChiNext (.CNT) , voltado para startups, caiu 3,4%, e o índice STAR50 de Xangai (.STAR50) , com foco em tecnologia, despencou 4,8%, atingindo o nível mais baixo desde março. Mais cedo, os índices haviam subido até 1,2% e 0,8%, respectivamente.
Na região, as ações asiáticas subiram na terça-feira, à medida que o tão aguardado pedido de IPO da empresa de IA Anthropic aumentou o apetite pelo risco, antecipando os resultados financeiros do setor de tecnologia — que serão um teste para o mercado de IA — e as reuniões dos bancos centrais, que influenciarão as taxas de juros no curto prazo.
A onda de vendas de ações chinesas relacionadas à IA, no entanto, continuou, com o índice CSI de chips (.CSI931865) caindo 5,8%, atingindo uma nova mínima de seis meses, e o índice CSI de IA (.CSI930713) recuando quase 4%.
O índice CSI de Bancos (.CSI399986) , considerado defensivo, registrou alta de 1,3%.
. Em TÓQUIO, o índice Nikkei (.N225) avançou 1,73%, a 63.268 pontos.
. Em HONG KONG, o índice HANG SENG (.HSI) caiu 0,73%, a 23.041 pontos.
. Em XANGAI, o índice SSEC (.SSEC) perdeu 1,33%, a 3.648 pontos.
. O índice CSI300 (.CSI300) , que reúne as maiores companhias listadas em XANGAI e SHENZHEN, retrocedeu 1,32%, a 4.049 pontos.
. Em SEUL, o índice KOSPI (.KS11) teve valorização de 3,09%, a 5.638 pontos.
. Em TAIWAN, o índice TAIEX (.TWII) registrou alta de 0,12%, a 46.096 pontos.
. Em CINGAPURA, o índice STRAITS TIMES (.STI) desvalorizou-se 0,35%, a 5.397 pontos.
. Em SYDNEY, o índice S&P/ASX 200 (.AXJO) avançou 0,46%, a 8.850 pontos.
(Reportagem de Jiaxing Li, em Hong Kong)

items.title: Norway's prime minister, Finland's president in phone call with Putin
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Finnish President Alexander Stubb and Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Stoere on Tuesday held a phone call with Russian President Vladimir Putin regarding the war in Ukraine, Stubb's office said in a statement.
items.body:
Finnish President Alexander Stubb and Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Stoere on Tuesday held a phone call with Russian President Vladimir Putin regarding the war in Ukraine, Stubb's office said in a statement.
Western European leaders have mostly shunned contact with Putin since Russia launched its full-scale war in Ukraine in February 2022.
"The discussion was frank and substantive. We are neighbouring countries to Russia. The outcome of this war will have a direct impact on our and the broader European security. Ending the war requires direct discussions," Stubb said in a statement.
Russia has frequently accused European governments of stoking the war by arming Ukraine and refusing to talk to Moscow.
It has contrasted their stance with that of US President Donald Trump, who has engaged with Putin and tried - so far without success - to broker a peace agreement.
Stoere and Stubb met US special envoy Steve Witkoff and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy in Oslo last week, a day before Witkoff met Putin in St Petersburg.
The Kremlin said after the Putin-Witkoff talks that Russia was willing to resume US-mediated peace talks with Ukraine in November, for the first time since February.

items.title: Marcas chinas rompen con Mbappé tras sus supuestos comentarios sobre un meme de Mao
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Varias marcas chinas han roto sus vínculos con Kylian Mbappé tras la polémica por sus presuntos comentarios sobre un meme con una imagen que se asemejaba al fallecido líder chino Mao Zedong.
items.body:
Varias marcas chinas han roto sus vínculos con Kylian Mbappé tras la polémica por sus presuntos comentarios sobre un meme con una imagen que se asemejaba al fallecido líder chino Mao Zedong.
En un video que apareció en internet el lunes, se oye a Mbappé decir que el meme más divertido que había visto sobre sí mismo era uno en el que su rostro se había fusionado con el de "un dictador chino".
Los aficionados han estado creando memes que superponen el rostro de Mbappé a imágenes de líderes militares y políticos como alusión al poder que supuestamente tiene de tomar las decisiones en los equipos en los que juega.
Reuters no ha podido verificar la autenticidad del video.
Mao, fundador de la República Popular China, es venerado por muchos como el salvador de la nación y las bromas sobre él se consideran tabú. Murió en 1976.
En un comunicado publicado en la red social china Weibo, Eastroc Beverage, que utilizaba el rostro de Mbappé en sus bebidas, afirmó que se oponía firmemente a "los comportamientos que hieren el sentimiento nacional".
"Con efecto inmediato, ponemos fin a toda colaboración con Kylian Mbappé", añadió.
Los representantes de Mbappé no respondieron de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios.
En una entrevista con L'Équipe el mes pasado, Mbappé dijo que, si bien algunos aspectos de esa tendencia eran una diversión inofensiva, los memes virales que lo representaban como un dictador mostraban "una falta de conciencia política y humana".
Las empresas lácteas Mengniu y Milkground también pusieron fin a su colaboración con Mbappé.
A preguntas acerca del incidente, un portavoz del Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores de China respondió que las palabras y acciones que hieren los sentimientos del pueblo chino "se encontrarán, naturalmente, con la oposición conjunta de todos los sectores de la sociedad china".
La televisión estatal china ha suspendido las transmisiones de todos los partidos y eventos relacionados con LaLiga y Mbappé, y se han retirado todos los anuncios en los que aparece el futbolista, informó el martes el medio estatal The Paper.
LaLiga y el Real Madrid no respondieron de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios.

Oct 27 : European shares slipped on Tuesday, dragged down by banking stocks, after disappointing results from HSBC, while investors also turned cautious ahead of US tech earnings, seen as a key test of the AI trade, and central bank meetings that could shape near-term interest-rate outlook.
The STOXX 600 banking sector slid 1.3 per cent, with shares of Europe's largest lender down 7 per cent after missing revenue expectations for the July-September quarter due to slower growth at its wealth business, while pretax profit was in line with estimates.
The pan-European STOXX 600 dipped 0.2 per cent, while London's FTSE 100 index declined 1 per cent, largely as a result of the drop in HSBC shares.  
"Banks have been the winners of the latest quarter before this one, reporting record results because of high volatility and because of AI financing," said Ipek Ozkardeskaya, a senior market analyst at Swissquote Bank.

"But right now, they are coming under pressure because we do see the interest rate rise, short-term yields rising more than long-term; that's basically eating into the income revenue," she added.
"But I still think that the banks are in a good position to outperform the other sectors, especially sectors that are more vulnerable to directly rising living costs."
Quarterly earnings are the central focus globally, as investors weigh up the impact of the conflict in Iran, including higher costs and interest rates, on corporate performance.
EARNINGS DELUGE
In the US this week, more than a third of S&P 500 companies are expected to report and the scrutiny of AI hyperscalers including Microsoft, Amazon and Alphabet will be intense, as investors seek signs that these companies' billion-dollar investments are yielding returns as expected.
"We remain medium-term bullish on the 'picks and shovels' trade. We see capex cycle remaining strong and the earnings remaining robust," Mohit Kumar, an economist at Jefferies, said.
"However, we do admit that, as with any cycle, there would be winners and losers in the AI trade and a number of companies will not remain profitable and even go bust."
Big Tech earnings could determine appetite for the eagerly awaited public debut of AI bellwether Anthropic and Meta Platforms' $95-billion equity fundraising.
Claude-owner Anthropic disclosed a steep loss, but red-hot revenue growth, in its filing for a US initial public offering on Monday and is expected to list before the end of November.  
The enthusiasm around Anthropic lifted stocks in Asia and helped MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan rise 0.1 per cent. Nasdaq futures were muted after strong gains in the previous session.
CENTRAL BANKS EXPECTED TO STAY ON HOLD
Policy decisions from the Federal Reserve, European Central Bank and Bank of Japan are due later this week, with economists expecting all three to stand pat on interest rates, leaving the focus on comments from policymakers to gauge the rates outlook.
Fed policymakers have telegraphed they will not raise short-term borrowing costs again on Wednesday, but with inflation concerns still front and centre, investors believe a rate-hike pause will not last for long. Traders are pricing in a 25 basis point hike from the Fed in December, the CME Group's FedWatch Tool showed.
The euro eased 0.1 per cent and at $1.115 it was near the May low it hit two weeks ago.
The yield on the US 10-year Treasury note was steady at 4.986 per cent, staying below 5 per cent which it breached in September as investors scurried to Treasuries for safety during stock market tumult over AI worries. 
The outlook for interest rates could depend on the outcome of ongoing talks with Tehran, even as Yemen's Houthis continue to attack Saudi Arabia. Brent crude prices rose 0.6 per cent to $116.82 per barrel. 
Spot gold prices eased 0.6 per cent to $3,992.70 per ounce.

FAST

Oct 27 : European shares slipped on Tuesday, dragged down by banking stocks, after disappointing results from HSBC, while investors also turned cautious ahead of US tech earnings, seen as a key test of the AI trade, and central bank meetings that could shape near-term interest-rate outlook.
The STOXX 600 banking sector slid 1.3 per cent, with shares of Europe's largest lender down 7 per cent after missing revenue expectations for the July-September quarter due to slower growth at its wealth business, while pretax profit was in line with estimates.
The pan-European STOXX 600 dipped 0.2 per cent, while London's FTSE 100 index declined 1 per cent, largely as a result of the drop in HSBC shares.  
"Banks have been the winners of the latest quarter before this one, reporting record results because of high volatility and because of AI financing," said Ipek Ozkardeskaya, a senior market analyst at Swissquote Bank.

"But right now, they are coming under pressure because we do see the interest rate rise, short-term yields rising more than long-term; that's basically eating into the income revenue," she added.
"But I still think that the banks are in a good position to outperform the other sectors, especially sectors that are more vulnerable to directly rising living costs."
Quarterly earnings are the central focus globally, as investors weigh up the impact of the conflict in Iran, including higher costs and interest rates, on corporate performance.
EARNINGS DELUGE
In the US this week, more than a third of S&P 500 companies are expected to report and the scrutiny of AI hyperscalers including Microsoft, Amazon and Alphabet will be intense, as investors seek signs that these companies' billion-dollar investments are yielding returns as expected.
"We remain medium-term bullish on the 'picks and shovels' trade. We see capex cycle remaining strong and the earnings remaining robust," Mohit Kumar, an economist at Jefferies, said.
"However, we do admit that, as with any cycle, there would be winners and losers in the AI trade and a number of companies will not remain profitable and even go bust."
Big Tech earnings could determine appetite for the eagerly awaited public debut of AI bellwether Anthropic and Meta Platforms' $95-billion equity fundraising.
Claude-owner Anthropic disclosed a steep loss, but red-hot revenue growth, in its filing for a US initial public offering on Monday and is expected to list before the end of November.  
The enthusiasm around Anthropic lifted stocks in Asia and helped MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan rise 0.1 per cent. Nasdaq futures were muted after strong gains in the previous session.
CENTRAL BANKS EXPECTED TO STAY ON HOLD
Policy decisions from the Federal Reserve, European Central Bank and Bank of Japan are due later this week, with economists expecting all three to stand pat on interest rates, leaving the focus on comments from policymakers to gauge the rates outlook.
Fed policymakers have telegraphed they will not raise short-term borrowing costs again on Wednesday, but with inflation concerns still front and centre, investors believe a rate-hike pause will not last for long. Traders are pricing in a 25 basis point hike from the Fed in December, the CME Group's FedWatch Tool showed.
The euro eased 0.1 per cent and at $1.115 it was near the May low it hit two weeks ago.
The yield on the US 10-year Treasury note was steady at 4.986 per cent, staying below 5 per cent which it breached in September as investors scurried to Treasuries for safety during stock market tumult over AI worries. 
The outlook for interest rates could depend on the outcome of ongoing talks with Tehran, even as Yemen's Houthis continue to attack Saudi Arabia. Brent crude prices rose 0.6 per cent to $116.82 per barrel. 
Spot gold prices eased 0.6 per cent to $3,992.70 per ounce.

FAST

BEIJING: China is highly concerned about conflicts in the Middle East and surrounding regions and Beijing will send an envoy to the relevant countries in the near future, foreign ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said at a daily press conference on Tuesday (Oct 27).
Guo called on related parties to resolve differences through dialogue and negotiation and also expressed concerns about the spillover and transmitting of the Middle East conflict to the Horn of Africa and the Red Sea region.
"China will soon send a special envoy to visit countries in the regions to strengthen communication with relevant parties, promote contact and dialogue, help ease tensions and prevent the situation from deteriorating further," Guo said.
Top officials from Saudi Arabia, Türkiye and Pakistan met Iranian officials in Tehran on Monday to de-escalate the Middle East conflict, as Yemen's Houthis launched new attacks on Saudi Arabia and Egypt approved defence support for the Gulf kingdom.
Meanwhile, tensions between the US and Iran have sharpened recently with President Donald Trump saying last week that his country may strike Iran again.
Last week, the foreign ministers of China and Djibouti met in Beijing, where they agreed that easing tensions in the Middle East is key to addressing security challenges in the Horn of Africa and the Red Sea.

Source: Reuters/ec

items.title: Iraqi court sentences six French men to life in prison for Islamic State membership
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: An Iraqi court on Tuesday sentenced six French nationals to life in prison and a seventh to 15 years after convicting them of membership in Islamic State, a Reuters witness inside the courtroom said.
items.body:
An Iraqi court on Tuesday sentenced six French nationals to life in prison and a seventh to 15 years after convicting them of membership in Islamic State, a Reuters witness inside the courtroom said.
The men were among 47 French Islamic State suspects transferred from detention facilities in northeast Syria to Iraq last year under a broader relocation arrangement coordinated by US forces and Iraqi authorities.
The presiding judge said the sentences were imposed under Iraq's counterterrorism law for joining Islamic State and spreading fear. He added that the court had opted for life imprisonment rather than the death penalty because the defendants were young.
A seventh French national, aged 23, was given a 15-year sentence, according to the Reuters witness.
Abbas al-Maliki, one of the lawyers for the defendants, said the group would appeal the sentence in the Court of Cassation.
Iraq [USN:L6N45C01V TEXT:"opened"] the trial of the French nationals last month.
Islamic State seized large parts of Iraq and Syria in 2014 before being driven from its self-declared caliphate by a US-led coalition and local forces in 2019. Many of the group's militants were detained, although remnants of the jihadist organization continue to operate.
The United States announced in January that it had begun [USN:L1N3YN16J TEXT:"transferring"] Islamic State detainees from Syria to Iraq amid concerns about the security of detention facilities in northeast Syria after Kurdish-led forces lost control of parts of the region.

items.title: アングル：ＴＯＰＩＸ銘柄入れ替え・比率変更、期日接近でリバランス活発化
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Noriyuki Hirata

[東京 ２７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Noriyuki Hirata

[東京 ２７日 ロイター] - ＴＯＰＩＸの定期銘柄入れ替えや１０月の浮動株比率（ＦＦＷ）変更が近づく中、指数に連動するパッシブファンドなどがポジションを構築する動きが改めて意識されている。銘柄入れ替えに伴う思惑は今月前半の正式発表でいったんの節目を迎えたが、入れ替え日の前日に当たる２９日の大引けにかけて、実際のリバランスの動きが強まるとの観測が出ている。

「買い需要が見込まれる銘柄が買われ、売り需要銘柄が売られるといったリバランス本来の動きが、今週入り後に加速しているようだ」とフィリップ・キャピタル証券の増沢丈彦株式部トレーディング・ヘッドは指摘する。

ＴＯＰＩＸの銘柄入れ替えを巡る思惑は、主要な証券会社各社による事前の推計を受けて、定期入れ替えの基準日となった８月３１日以降、織り込みが進んだ。１０月７日に正式な銘柄が公表されたことで、思惑に基づく売買は一巡したと市場では受け止められている。

実際、増沢氏が買い需要と売り需要が見込まれる銘柄群の値動きについて集計したところ、買い需要・売り需要が見込まれる銘柄群は、事前予想に基づく売買がみられ、その後の正式発表を経て、いったん出尽くしとなった様子がうかがえる。「ある程度、手垢がついており、あまり妙味はないのではないか」（しんきんアセットマネジメント投信の藤原直樹シニアファンド・マネージャー）との見方は多い。

ところが２６日以降、再び流れが反転している。ＴＯＰＩＸをベンチマークとするパッシブ連動資金を中心に「期日が迫る中で実需に向けたポジション構築の動きが本格化してきているものと推察される」（増沢氏）という。

数日分の売買代金に相当する資金移動のインパクトが見込まれる銘柄があることも要因の一つとみられる。例えば、新規採用の日本マクドナルドホールディングスは約１７日分と見込まれている。

今回の銘柄入れ替えやＦＦＷの変更では、売り買い双方で約４．８兆円のリバランスが想定されるという。買いはキオクシアホールディングス約９７４８億円、アドバンテスト約１９５５億円、リクルートホールディングス約１４７２億円、売りは三菱商事約２３９８億円、村田製作所約２３０６億円、三菱ＵＦＪフィナンシャル・グループ約１７７０億円などと推計されている。

こうしたリバランスの動きは、銘柄入れ替えやＦＦＷの見直しが指数に反映される３０日の前日２９日の大引けにかけて続く可能性があると増沢氏は話す。採用銘柄間の資金移動となるため、ＴＯＰＩＸへの影響はニュートラルとなる一方、ＡＩ関連の主力株で買い需要が見込まれており「日経平均の支援材料になり得る」という。

＜除外候補銘柄の動向に関心継続＞

銘柄入れ替えに関しては、２７年に向けた動きへの関心が継続している。「まだ間があるが、拾える銘柄を探していくのは面白そうだ」（しんきんＡＭの藤原氏）との声がある。

除外候補となった銘柄もすぐに除外されるわけではない。段階的にウエートが低減されながら、２７年１０月の再評価で継続基準を満たす銘柄はウエート低減が停止される。

基準日となる来年８月末に向けて、まず「ＴＯＰＩＸに残る意思があるかが焦点」と東海東京インテリジェンス・ラボの山藤将太エクイティマーケットアナリストは指摘する。

その上で、ＴＯＰＩＸに残る意思を示す企業は、株主還元などを通じて株価を引き上げようとするか、浮動株時価総額を引き上げるため需給悪化につながる売り出しなどに動くかがポイントになる山藤氏は話している。

items.title: La demanda de hipotecas cae en la eurozona mientras suben las tasas, según una encuesta del BCE
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La demanda de hipotecas en la zona euro cayó con fuerza en los tres meses hasta septiembre, en un contexto de subidas de las tasas de interés y mayores dificultades para acceder al crédito, según una encuesta del Banco Central Europeo publicada el martes.
items.body:
La demanda de hipotecas en la zona euro cayó con fuerza en los tres meses hasta septiembre, en un contexto de subidas de las tasas de interés y mayores dificultades para acceder al crédito, según una encuesta del Banco Central Europeo publicada el martes.
La encuesta trimestral sobre préstamos bancarios del BCE mostró el impacto tangible del endurecimiento de la política monetaria de la entidad, que comenzó en junio y se prevé que continúe durante meses, en respuesta al repunte de la inflación en la zona euro impulsado por la guerra.
Un porcentaje neto del 27% de los bancos informó de una disminución de la demanda de préstamos para la compra de vivienda en el tercer trimestre del año, una caída más pronunciada de lo que las entidades habían previsto (-12%) y de la que habían comunicado en los tres meses anteriores (-15%).
"Las subidas de las tasas de interés fueron el principal factor de la caída, seguidas del descenso de la confianza de los consumidores y del deterioro de las perspectivas del mercado de la vivienda", señaló el BCE en un comunicado.
Los bancos no endurecieron los criterios para conceder hipotecas durante el trimestre, aunque sí lo hicieron para los préstamos a empresas y el crédito al consumo. Prevén endurecer los criterios de concesión de todo tipo de préstamos en los últimos tres meses del año.
Francia, que se encuentra en el centro de las turbulencias del mercado de bonos por la situación de sus finanzas públicas, fue el gran país europeo donde ese endurecimiento fue más pronunciado.
"La mayor percepción de riesgos y la menor tolerancia al riesgo de los bancos siguieron siendo los principales factores del endurecimiento de los criterios de concesión de crédito, y algunas entidades señalaron una creciente presión derivada de la incertidumbre geopolítica y de la evolución del sector energético", indicó el BCE.
Preguntados por la inteligencia artificial, la mayoría de los bancos señaló que aún no había introducido criterios cuantitativos para evaluar los préstamos relacionados con la IA, y sólo un pequeño número afirmó que esta figuraba cada vez más en sus evaluaciones cualitativas.
items.raw_description: La demanda de hipotecas en la zona euro cayó con fuerza en los tres meses hasta septiembre, en un contexto de subidas de las tasas de interés y mayores dificultades para acceder al crédito, según una encuesta del Banco Central Europeo publicada el martes.

items.title: Brewers eye sweep for first Series title, while Rays try to stay alive
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: ST. PETERSBURG, Fla. -- The Milwaukee Brewers will bid to make history Tuesday in more ways than one.
items.body:
ST. PETERSBURG, Fla. -- The Milwaukee Brewers will bid to make history Tuesday in more ways than one.
Sure, the Brewers will vie for the franchise's first World Series title when they play Game 4 against the Tampa Bay Rays.
Should they complete a sweep, they'll be the first team to accomplish the feat in both the League Championship Series and the World Series since the LCS became a best-of-seven set in 1985. The 1976 Cincinnati Reds swept the Philadelphia Phillies in a best-of-five National League Championship Series before brushing aside the New York Yankees in the World Series.
Milwaukee has won all three games of the Fall Classic, eight straight dating to the NL Division Series and 10 of 11 postseason games overall.
The Brewers put themselves in position to bring out the brooms after eking out a pair of one-run victories before erupting for eight runs with two outs in the fifth inning of a 10-1 rout Monday.
While Milwaukee is looking to end the series, Tampa Bay is simply trying to extend it.
The Rays are attempting to overcome a 0-3 deficit in a best-of-seven series for only the second time in MLB history. The 2004 Boston Red Sox accomplished the feat after rebounding from a 19-8 loss to the rival New York Yankees in Game 3 to win the final four games of the American League Championship Series.
"We've got nothing to lose, so we might as well play like it," said Tampa Bay's Cam Booser, who allowed four runs on four hits without recording an out in relief of starter Freddy Peralta in Game 3.
Right-hander Griffin Jax (0-1, 6.00 ERA) will try to help the Rays stave off elimination as the Game 4 starter.
Jax has not pitched since taking the loss in Game 3 of the ALCS against the Cleveland Guardians, allowing three runs on five hits over four innings in Tampa Bay's 3-2 road loss Oct. 15.
He did not allow a hit over one scoreless inning in a no-decision against Milwaukee on March 30, but struggled two days later. He surrendered five runs, three earned, on three hits without recording an out in an 8-2 loss to the Brewers.
Jax, 31, is 0-3 with a 6.75 ERA in 12 career appearances, including one start, against Milwaukee.
He will need to be careful against Jackson Chourio, who capped an eight-run fifth inning Monday with an RBI double as part of a four-hit performance.
Chourio is 8-for-14 with four runs in the first three games of the World Series.
"He's a special player, not just a special hitter. He's just so talented. I think people forget how young he is," Brewers hitting coach Daniel Vogelbach said. "He's just a kid. He could be playing college baseball right now."
William Contreras collected three hits Monday to improve to 7-for-13 with three RBIs in the World Series. He is 18-for-43 with three home runs, eight RBIs and six runs in the postseason overall.
The Brewers had not announced their Game 4 starter. Brandon Woodruff said he was scheduled to open Tuesday's game before pitching the ninth inning in Game 3.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Beiersdorf CEO says company is 'there to stay' in Russia
items.author: Cian Muenster, Paolo Laudani
items.creator: Cian Muenster, Paolo Laudani
items.summary: German skincare company Beiersdorf has no plans to leave Russia, its chief executive said on Tuesday, arguing the company needed to remain in the country to protect the Nivea brand after a dispute with a local business partner hurt third-quarter sales.
items.body:
German skincare company Beiersdorf (BEIG.DE) has no plans to leave Russia, its chief executive said on Tuesday, arguing the company needed to remain in the country to protect the Nivea brand after a dispute with a local business partner hurt third-quarter sales.
The maker of Nivea said a commercial [USN:S8N44P04I TEXT:"dispute"] involving its Russian subsidiary and a local business partner weighed on third-quarter performance, but that the matter had been resolved and normal operations had resumed.
"We are there to stay in Russia with our brand, protecting the brand, paying the salary for people," CEO Vincent Warnery told analysts on a call.
Beiersdorf is among a shrinking number of Western consumer goods companies that continue to operate in Russia more than four years after Moscow's invasion of Ukraine, even as many foreign firms have exited the market.
Warnery said there was no change to the company's Russia strategy, arguing that remaining in the country helped protect the Nivea brand, which Beiersdorf has sold there since 1906.
"We know that if we had left Russia, somebody else could have produced Nivea without us. So we are there to protect the brand and to pay the salaries of our employees. Nothing more, nothing less," he said.
Sales in Eastern Europe fell 14.6% in the third quarter, but were down just 1.3% excluding Russia.

items.title: インド・プライバシー法は事前検閲、報道機関が最高裁で訴え
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Aditya Kalra

[ニューデリー ２７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Aditya Kalra

[ニューデリー ２７日 ロイター] - インドのメディア団体は２７日、記者が記事で取り上げる人物の同意を得ることを義務付ける政府のプライバシー法について、事前検閲に当たり、報道機関の閉鎖につながりかねないと最高裁で訴えた。

ロイターは２６日、報道機関２１社が、同法は調査報道を踏みにじり、インド政府による記者の情報源の特定を可能にするとして異議を申し立てたと報じていた。

デジタルニュース出版社協会（ＤＮＰＡ）の代理人を務める弁護士は裁判官らに「ニュースとは何かという概念を根本から変えるものだ」と述べた。「許可を求めなければならないなら報道機関は閉鎖に追い込まれる。そうなれば完全な事前検閲体制だ」と訴えた。

報道機関側が今月初めに提出した書面によると、メディア各社は８月の政府との会合で、同法は報道の自由を守るとの確約を得た。しかし欧州連合（ＥＵ）やシンガポール、英国とは異なり、記者を適用対象から除外する規定が明文化されていないことに危機感を抱いているという。

報道機関側は２０２７年５月から適用される同法の問題条項の大半を無効にするよう求めている。同法により記事の削除を強いられる可能性があるほか、政府が報道機関に情報の提出を要求する権限を得ることで、記者の情報源が明らかになりかねないと主張している。

items.summary: The most pressing policy question facing the US — how to restore fiscal control — has been conspicuously absent in campaigning for the midterm elections. Neither party is willing to frame a plausible way to solve the problem, so they’ve seemingly agreed not to discuss it. Their silence is an abject failure of governance. One wonders how much longer Washington will be able to get away with it.

items.title: India's Radico Khaitan quarterly profit jumps on premium spirits demand
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Indian liquor maker Radico Khaitan reported a 66% rise in quarterly profit on Tuesday, as robust demand for luxury and premium spirits lifted margins.
items.body:
Indian liquor maker Radico Khaitan (RADC.NS) reported a 66% rise in quarterly profit on Tuesday, as robust demand for luxury and premium spirits lifted margins.
The maker of Jaisalmer craft gin and Royal Ranthambore whisky has been benefiting from a pivot from its popular portfolio to premium offerings, which carry higher margins and tend to see more resilient, less price-sensitive demand.
Here are some details:
The liquor maker posted a consolidated net profit of 2.32 billion rupees ($24.39 million) for the quarter ended September 30, up from 1.4 billion rupees a year earlier
Overall core profit margin expanded 462 basis points to 20.4%
Revenue from operations rose 10.4% year-on-year to 55.8 billion rupees
Volume in the company's higher-end "prestige and above" segment grew 36% during the quarter, driven by higher sales for vodka
The company said that a rationalised duty framework in Karnataka is showing early signs of a more premium-friendly market, with encouraging signals from Tamil Nadu as well
The company separately announced on Tuesday that it would bring finance chief Dilip Banthiya onto the board as an executive director alongside CFO duties effective October 28
It also said that Senior Vice President Saket Somani would serve as deputy chief financial officer from the same date
Shares of the company rose about 2% to 4,285 rupees in afternoon trading
($1 = 95.1350 Indian rupees)

The number of confirmed Ebola cases in Democratic Republic of Congo has risen above 10,000, government data showed on Tuesday (Oct 27), a milestone that coincides with growing fears the epidemic could spread to more African countries.
The latest situation report from Congo's public health institute put the number of cases at 10,060, with those killed by the virus reaching 4,887.
The outbreak, caused by the rare Bundibugyo species of Ebola, was announced in mid-May and has since become the largest and deadliest in Congo, surpassing a 2018-2020 epidemic.
It is now the second-largest and second-deadliest on record behind only the 2014-2016 West African Ebola outbreak, which infected over 28,600 people and killed more than 11,000, mainly in Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone.

Earlier this month, Kenya reported its first case and went on to announce nine cases in total, after a man who had travelled from Congo via Uganda died in Nairobi.
Last week, Nigeria became the fourth African country to report an Ebola case.
Health officials have been seeking to work out how and where the patient - the wife of a Swiss diplomat, who had not travelled to Congo - contracted the disease. The Swiss government said she was believed to have contracted it in Uganda.
The woman and her husband were flown to hospitals in Switzerland on Monday.
Uganda reported 20 cases in May and June, mostly imported from Congo, but the World Health Organization declared the country Ebola-free in August.
Ugandan officials say the country does not have any Ebola cases.
Uganda's health minister said on Sunday that Ugandan citizens returning to the country with a history of travel to Congo would be quarantined for 21 days.

items.title: Receita do HSBC no 3º tri fica abaixo das estimativas; ações caem
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O HSBC divulgou nesta terça-feira um salto no lucro trimestral, mas a receita ficou abaixo das estimativas, em parte devido ao crescimento mais lento em seu segmento de gestão de patrimônio, o que levou as ações do banco a uma queda de 6%.
items.body:
O HSBC (HSBA.L) divulgou nesta terça-feira um salto no lucro trimestral, mas a receita ficou abaixo das estimativas, em parte devido ao crescimento mais lento em seu segmento de gestão de patrimônio, o que levou as ações do banco a uma queda de 6%.
O maior banco da Europa divulgou que o lucro antes dos impostos subiu 32%, para US$9,6 bilhões, no trimestre de julho a setembro, em linha com as estimativas, e lançou um programa de recompra de ações de até US$1 bilhão, o mesmo valor do trimestre anterior.
No entanto, a receita ficou abaixo das previsões dos analistas, que apontavam para US$19 bilhões, registrando um crescimento de 5%, para US$18,6 bilhões.
A queda nas ações do banco listadas em Hong Kong ( ) ressalta como os recentes resultados sólidos dos bancos europeus aumentaram as expectativas dos investidores em relação ao desempenho, mesmo com o impacto da guerra no Irã sobre a inflação e as taxas de juros tornando o ambiente mais difícil para os bancos. As ações continuam com alta de 9% no acumulado do ano.
“Às vezes, há uma expectativa do mercado de que revisemos para cima nossas orientações ou metas”, disse a diretora financeira Pam Kaur a repórteres em uma teleconferência, quando questionada sobre a queda das ações.
A receita da divisão de gestão de patrimônio do HSBC ficou estável em US$2,7 bilhões. Isso se compara a um crescimento de receita de 15% e 23% em relação ao mesmo período do ano anterior nos dois primeiros trimestres.
BANCOS BRITÂNICOS SE PREPARAM PARA AUMENTOS DE IMPOSTOS O HSBC se beneficiou da ausência de provisões legais contabilizadas no mesmo trimestre do ano anterior. O banco também informou que as perdas de crédito esperadas caíram 17%, para US$800 milhões, graças a uma redução nas despesas relacionadas ao setor imobiliário de Hong Kong, bem como aos seus negócios de gestão de patrimônio no Reino Unido e no México.
O HSBC afirmou que está no caminho para atingir suas metas de lucratividade principal até 2028, mais um sinal de como as instituições financeiras da região têm mantido lucros robustos nos últimos anos.
O forte desempenho intensificou os apelos de ativistas no mercado doméstico do HSBC, no Reino Unido, por aumentos de impostos sobre os bancos no primeiro orçamento do ministro das Finanças, John Healey, previsto para quarta-feira.
Os executivos dos bancos têm feito forte lobby para evitar tal aumento nas tributações do setor, argumentando que isso restringiria os empréstimos e tornaria o Reino Unido menos competitivo.
O HSBC anunciou um dividendo intermediário de US$ 0,1 por ação, o mesmo valor do trimestre anterior.
(Reportagem de Selena Li, em Hong Kong, e Lawrence White, em Londres)

items.title: Nvidia e Meta estreitam laços na área de IA com acordo de investimento de US$3 bi
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A Nvidia e a Meta anunciaram nesta terça-feira que irão aprofundar sua parceria em torno do assistente de IA Muse e de modelos de IA relacionados, com a Nvidia investindo US$3 bilhões na oferta de ações da controladora do Facebook.
items.body:
A Nvidia (NVDA.O) e a Meta (META.O) anunciaram nesta terça-feira que irão aprofundar sua parceria em torno do assistente de IA Muse e de modelos de IA relacionados, com a Nvidia investindo US$3 bilhões na oferta de ações da controladora do Facebook.
Os modelos e agentes Muse da Meta, que rodam na infraestrutura da Nvidia, trabalharão em colaboração mais estreita com a fabricante de chips para melhorar o desempenho e reduzir custos.
O Muse, conhecido internamente como Hatch, é fundamental para o plano do presidente-executivo Mark Zuckerberg de oferecer “superinteligência pessoal” aos bilhões de pessoas que utilizam os serviços da Meta diariamente.
Inspirado no agente de IA de código aberto OpenClaw, o Muse pode acessar emails, calendário, pagamentos, informações de saúde, compras e aplicativos de casa inteligente do usuário, sendo que os usuários podem revogar o acesso a qualquer momento.
A Meta também aumentou sua oferta de ações para US$97,5 bilhões, a maior captação de recursos de sua história, à medida que acelera os investimentos em infraestrutura de IA.
As empresas podem explorar uma colaboração mais estreita na estrutura OpenShell da Nvidia, incluindo o uso dessa estrutura para implantar software com segurança e o uso de uma ferramenta chamada Sentry para monitorar o comportamento dos agentes de IA.
(Reportagem de Shivani Tanna em Bengaluru)

items.title: OPEC+ oil producers set to keep output targets steady at Sunday meeting, sources say
items.author: Olesya Astakhova, Ahmad Ghaddar
items.creator: Olesya Astakhova, Ahmad Ghaddar
items.summary: OPEC+ oil-producing countries are likely to keep their December oil output targets steady on Sunday, three people with knowledge of the matter told Reuters, in line with expectations that further output policy adjustments are unlikely until next year.
items.body:
OPEC+ oil-producing countries are likely to keep their December oil output targets steady on Sunday, three people with knowledge of the matter told Reuters, in line with expectations that further output policy adjustments are unlikely until next year.
The online meeting of seven core OPEC+ members — Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Algeria, Kazakhstan and Oman — comes as Gulf members have been boosting exports that have been disrupted for months by the Iran war . Most, however, are still pumping well below their output targets.

items.title: AFC to refer Jordan FA chief to judicial bodies over Infantino claims
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Asian Football Confederation (AFC) on Tuesday said it would refer Jordan Football Association President Prince Ali bin Hussein to its judicial bodies, after he accused FIFA President Gianni Infantino of hijacking the AFC Congress for political purposes.
items.body:
The Asian Football Confederation (AFC) on Tuesday said it would refer Jordan Football Association President Prince Ali bin Hussein to its judicial bodies, after he accused FIFA President Gianni Infantino of hijacking the AFC Congress for political purposes.
At the AFC's extraordinary congress in Tokyo on Friday, its president Sheikh Salman bin Ibrahim Al-Khalifa [USN:L1N46902J TEXT:"endorsed Infantino's bid for re-election"] as FIFA president.
Only three months after the confederation accused Infantino of a "fundamental breach of trust" over the abandoned FIFA Forward Enterprise (FFE) proposal to sell a stake in FIFA tournaments, Sheikh Salman told the congress that Asia was now united behind Infantino.
Following the congress, [USN:L3N46B01B TEXT:"Prince Ali alleged"] that nobody was allowed to speak, question, debate or talk with the media and that the last day of the event was "pure politics".
In response, the AFC said neither Prince Ali nor any other member association's representatives had requested to speak and that it rejected any suggestion that proceedings were conducted improperly.
"The AFC takes seriously the unsupported and entirely unsubstantiated allegations of coercion, threats or bribery. Such serious accusations must be supported by credible evidence and should not be made without a proper factual basis," it added.
"Accordingly, the AFC will refer the statements made by the President of the Jordan Football Association, including the allegations raised, to the relevant AFC judicial bodies for their consideration and any further action deemed appropriate in accordance with the AFC Statutes and applicable regulations."
In August, Prince Ali [USN:L4N4411O7 TEXT:"launched a public attack"] on Infantino, accusing him of "blackmail" and saying FIFA had offered to help solve the kingdom's problems in exchange for his endorsement.

items.title: Citi e BCA rebaixam recomendação de ativos brasileiros após reeleição de Lula
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O Citigroup e a BCA Research rebaixaram a recomendação dos ativos brasileiros após a vitória eleitoral do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, argumentando que o perfil de risco-retorno para ações, títulos e moeda se deteriorou, à medida que os investidores reavaliam as perspectivas de disciplina fiscal e reformas estruturais sob o novo governo.
items.body:
O Citigroup e a BCA Research rebaixaram a recomendação dos ativos brasileiros após a vitória eleitoral do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, argumentando que o perfil de risco-retorno para ações, títulos e moeda se deteriorou, à medida que os investidores reavaliam as perspectivas de disciplina fiscal e reformas estruturais sob o novo governo.
Essas avaliações refletem uma mudança mais ampla no posicionamento dos investidores, com estrategistas alertando que uma política fiscal mais flexível, uma dinâmica mais fraca da dívida pública e um avanço mais lento nas reformas voltadas para o crescimento podem pesar sobre os mercados brasileiros, apesar das restrições impostas por um Congresso mais conservador.
O Citi encerrou na segunda-feira suas posições bullish no Brasil após a vitória eleitoral de Lula, retirando sua recomendação de "overweight" em ações e encerrando sua posição comprada no real .
"Embora os preços possam muito bem cair além dos níveis justos, o mercado já estava otimista antes disso, o que torna plausível uma queda excessiva. Dado o resultado da eleição, encerramos nossa exposição ao risco no Brasil", afirmou o Citi.
Os ativos brasileiros despencaram na segunda-feira, com o real caindo mais de 11% em relação ao dólar e o índice de ações Bovespa (.BVSP) registrando uma queda de 13,9% — sua maior queda em um único dia desde março de 2020.
Os investidores esperam que as recentes apostas em uma mudança de governo sejam revertidas.
A BCA Research rebaixou, nesta segunda-feira, a recomendação do Brasil em relação aos mercados emergentes, afirmando que a vitória de Lula "acaba com a perspectiva de um governo ortodoxo que promova melhorias estruturais nas contas fiscais e no crescimento potencial do Brasil".
A BCA rebaixou as ações brasileiras de "neutro" para "underweight", citando riscos crescentes de inadimplência, perspectivas de crescimento mais fracas e pressões inflacionárias decorrentes de uma moeda mais fraca.
A empresa também rebaixou os títulos em moeda local e o crédito soberano do Brasil de "overweight" para "underweight", alertando para a deterioração da dinâmica da dívida.
(Reportagem de Rashika Singh em Bengaluru)

items.title: Zone euro-La croissance des prêts aux entreprises se maintient en septembre-BCE
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La croissance des prêts aux entreprises dans la zone euro est restée stable en septembre, montrent les données publiées mardi par la Banque centrale européenne (BCE).
items.body:
La croissance des prêts aux entreprises dans la zone euro est restée stable en septembre, montrent les données publiées mardi par la Banque centrale européenne (BCE).
Le crédit aux entreprises non-financières a progressé de 4,2% sur un an en septembre, après le même chiffre en août.
Les prêts aux ménages ont quant à eux augmenté de 3,1% en septembre, après le même chiffre le mois précédent.
La croissance de la masse monétaire en zone euro, qui peut influer sur la croissance économique, a augmenté de 3,5% en septembre, plus qu'anticipé dans le consensus Reuters (3,4%) et après +3,5% en août.

items.title: Meghan Markle participará en la edición australiana de MasterChef Junior el próximo año
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Meghan, esposa del príncipe Enrique de Reino Unido, protagonizará en 2027 la próxima temporada de MasterChef Junior Australia, con lo que regresará a una franquicia en cuya versión para adultos participó como jurado invitada este año.
items.body:
Meghan, esposa del príncipe Enrique de Reino Unido, protagonizará en 2027 la próxima temporada de MasterChef Junior Australia, con lo que regresará a una franquicia en cuya versión para adultos participó como jurado invitada este año.
Meghan, que era actriz en Estados Unidos antes de casarse con Enrique en 2018, se ha mudado recientemente de Estados Unidos a Reino Unido con su familia. Según informaciones de prensa, estaba interesada en encontrar un nuevo papel como actriz.
Channel 10 anunció en Instagram que MasterChef Junior Australia regresaría en 2027, con Poh Ling Yeow y Meghan, duquesa de Sussex, como presentadoras.
El sitio web australiano News.com.au informó de que estaba previsto que la grabación se realizara en Melbourne entre principios y mediados del próximo año.
Enrique y Meghan han atraído la atención de los medios de todo el mundo desde que en 2020 dejaron de ejercer como miembros de primera línea de la familia real, antes de trasladarse a Estados Unidos, donde concedieron varias entrevistas en las que criticaron a la institución.
La pareja volvió a acaparar titulares la semana pasada, después de que las autoridades de Filipinas anunciaran que investigaban si Thomas Markle, padre de Meghan, había poseído imágenes de abuso sexual infantil. Ella afirmó estar "profundamente consternada" por las acusaciones.

items.title: ポルシェ、1─9月期に利益回復　事業再編の成果が表れ始める
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Rachel More

[ベルリン ２７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Rachel More

[ベルリン ２７日 ロイター] - 独フォルクスワーゲン傘下のスポーツ車メーカー、ポルシェは２７日、今年１─９月期の利益が回復したと発表した。ミヒャエル・ライターズ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が進めるダウンサイジング・中国再編計画が成果を上げ始めていることを示す初期の兆候だ。

高利益率のフラッグシップモデル「９１１」の売上高は１２％増。ポルシェのラインアップの中で唯一売上高が増加した。

ライターズ氏は「戦略的再編を一貫して迅速に進めている。焦点は、中核事業、競争力のあるコスト構造、そして収益性の持続的な向上にある」と説明。「すでに実施された措置により、長期的に見て、ポルシェをより力強く、的を絞った、収益性の高い企業として位置づけるための条件を整えている」と述べた。

同社によると、９カ月間の営業利益は１７億４０００万ユーロ。前年同期は４０００万ユーロと低調だった。

売上高営業利益率は２０２５年に過去最低の１．１％を記録したが、この９カ月間では６．９％に改善し、通年目標の５．５─７．５％の範囲内に収まっている。
