items.title: 英ＨＳＢＣ、第3四半期32％増益　収入は市場予想下回る
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Selena Li　Lawrence White

[香港／ロンドン ２７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Selena Li　Lawrence White

[香港／ロンドン ２７日 ロイター] - 英金融大手ＨＳＢＣが２７日発表した第３・四半期決算は、大幅増益となったが、ウェルスマネジメント事業の伸び鈍化などで収入が市場予想を下回り、株価は６％下落した。 

税引前利益は３２％増の９６億ドルとなり、会社がまとめた予想通りだった。利上げが純利息収入を押し上げたほか、前年同期に計上された訴訟関連引当金がなくなったことを受けた。

一方、収入は５％増の１８６億ドルで、アナリスト予想の１９０億ドルに届かなかった。 

香港の不動産セクターおよび英国・メキシコのウェルスマネジメント事業に関連する費用の減少により、予想与信損失が前年同期比１７％減の８億ドルになった。

同社はまた、前四半期と同額の最大１０億ドル規模の自社株買いも発表した。

ウェルスマネジメント部門の収入は２７億ドルと横ばいだった。第１・四半期は前年同期比１５％増、第２・四半期は同２３％増だった。

ＨＳＢＣは、２０２８年までの主要な収益性目標の達成に向けて順調に進んでいると説明した。

銀行の資本規制「バーゼル３．１」によって、中核的自己資本比率が最大０．５ポイント押し上げられるとの見通しを示した。従来は「小幅」な押し上げ効果としていた。 

中間配当は１株当たり０．１ドルとし、前四半期と同額だった。

シティとジェフリーズのアナリストは、決算はやや物足りない内容だったと指摘した。ただ、いずれもウェルスマネジメント事業の預かり資産残高やプライベートバンキングの基調を見ると、事業の実態は収入の数字が示すよりも健全だとの見方を示した。

items.title: 焦点：中国の人工ダイヤ、宝飾品から転換　半導体・ＡＩ放熱で成長狙う
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Amy Lv　Casey Hall

[鄭州 （中国河南省）２７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Amy Lv　Casey Hall

[鄭州 （中国河南省）２７日 ロイター] - 中国河南省にあるフェン・ツァンジュン氏の工場では、年間２００万カラットの人工ダイヤモンドを生産している。そのうち、約７０パーセント（％）が宝飾品向けだ。

だがフェン氏は、中国の人工ダイヤモンド産業の将来は、半導体やＡＩサーバーなどハイテク用途向けの先端材料供給にあるとみている。

「機能性材料に使われる製品の割合を２０３０年までに５０％超に引き上げる一方、宝飾品向けの割合は最大でも３０％まで減らしたい」とフェン氏は語った。

世界の供給量の約半分を占める中国の人工ダイヤモンド生産者は、競争の激化と価格の下落圧力を受け、宝石以外の分野に目を向けている。

米中の技術覇権争いにおいて、人工ダイヤモンド産業の戦略的重要性が一段と増す可能性がある。人工ダイヤモンドが半導体やＡＩインフラの放熱（熱管理）に広く使われるようになれば、中国の生産面での優位性が、米国にとって新たなサプライチェーン上の弱点として浮上しかねない。

「この転換は今や、ダイヤモンド業界を規定する構造的な出来事であり、世界の技術サプライチェーンに直接影響を及ぼすものだ」。コンサルティング会社ケン・リサーチのエンゲージメントマネジャー、マナン・ゴエンカ氏はこう述べた。

企業やアナリストによると、半導体、放熱、量子技術などの分野からの需要が、同産業の次の主要な成長エンジンになり得る。人工ダイヤモンドは、先端的な電子機器やコンピューティングシステムの性能を高められる特性が評価されている。

ＡＩ技術の浸透により、データセンターの処理能力に対する需要は急増している。国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）は２０２５年の報告書で、データセンターの電力消費量は、ＡＩが主な押し上げ要因となって３０年までに２倍超の約９４５テラワット時に達する見通しだとしている。これは日本の年間電力消費量にほぼ匹敵する規模だ。

＜ＡＩが生む商機＞

アナリストがより短期的に商機があるとみているのが、放熱の分野での活用だ。半導体材料として広く商業利用するには、なお時間がかかる見通しだという。半導体用途は、切削・掘削工具に使われるダイヤモンドよりもはるかに高い純度と厳格な製造基準が求められる。

だが、ＡＩコンピューティングが発する熱の増加を背景に、世界有数の大手テクノロジー企業が人工ダイヤモンドの半導体用途への活用に関心を寄せ始めている。

中国メディアによると、華為技術（ファーウェイ）と台湾積体電路製造（ＴＳＭＣ）は半導体冷却向けの人工ダイヤモンド活用を検討しており、レノボはダイヤモンド・銅の冷却材を使った一般消費者向けノートパソコンを中国で発売した。

インテルのリップブー・タン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は６月、半導体グレードのダイヤモンドウエハーを開発する人工ダイヤモンドメーカー、ダイヤモンド・ファウンドリーに個人として出資したと明らかにした。

ファーウェイ、レノボ、インテルはコメント要請に応じなかった。ＴＳＭＣはコメントを拒否した。

一部の中国の生産者は、需要を見越して投資に動き始めている。河南力量鑽石は、宝石グレードのダイヤモンド生産拡大のために当初調達した１０億元（２３５億円）を、新たな機能性ダイヤモンド事業に振り向ける計画だと、６月の開示資料で明らかにした。

中国科学院寧波材料技術・工程研究所によると、中国の研究者が４月に開発したダイヤモンド・銅の冷却モジュールは、半導体モジュールからの熱伝達を８０％改善し、半導体の性能を１０％高めた。

採用が広がれば、半導体の過熱を防ぐために使われる放熱材料の市場が様変わりする可能性がある。ドイツのヘンケル、米化学大手ダウ、日本の信越化学工業は、半導体からの放熱に使われる製品を販売している。ダイヤモンド製のヒートスプレッダがＡＩ半導体やデータセンターに広く採用されれば、既存の一部材料と競合する可能性がある。

ヘンケル、ダウ、信越化はコメント要請に応じなかった。

ダイヤモンド関連製品の開発は中国国外でも進んでいる。デビアスの人工ダイヤモンド・先端材料事業エレメント・シックスと日本のオーブレーは６月、３インチの単結晶ダイヤモンド結晶の生産技術を確立し、米オレゴン州で２インチウエハーの生産準備を進めていると発表した。

スペイン政府は、トルヒーリョにあるダイヤモンド・ファウンドリーの工場に７億５３００万ユーロ（約１３２０億円）を投資している。この工場は人工ダイヤモンドウエハーを製造する予定で、完成すれば半導体製造用の材料であるダイヤモンド基板の欧州初の大規模生産拠点となる。

１０月上旬には、米放熱技術企業フロア・システムズが、ダイヤモンド製の熱拡散板を組み込んだ多段式コールドプレート「リキッドジェット・ダイヤモンド」を発表した。

「宝飾用ダイヤモンド小売事業は年間約１０００億ドル規模だが、技術・産業分野での可能性や潜在力はそれを大きく上回り得る」。独立系ダイヤモンドコンサルタントのロバート・ブーケ氏はこう述べた。

＜ダイヤモンド製造機＞

フェン氏の工場は、河南省に集まる数百の人工ダイヤモンド生産者の一つだ。同省は中国の人工ダイヤモンド生産量の８０％を占める。

人工ダイヤモンドは、天然ダイヤモンドが形成される高温・高圧の条件を再現する装置で作られる。採掘されるダイヤモンドと物理的に同一だ。

フェン氏の工場にある装置は、６日間で１２０カラットの原石を生産できる。天然ダイヤモンドであれば、数十億年かかる過程だという。

フェン氏は、１台当たり約３００万元、重さは１００トン超のこの装置を５５０台保有。２０１９年の事業開始以来、年間生産量を１０倍に増やし、２５年には２００万カラットに達した。これはデビアスの２５年の生産量の約９％に相当する。

中国政府はすでにこの技術を輸出管理体制に組み込んでおり、２４年に関連機械や主要部品を規制対象とした。２５年にはさらに広範な人工ダイヤモンド製品を規制リストに加えたが、昨年１０月に成立した米中合意に基づき、施行は１年延期された。

「人工ダイヤモンドは半導体、レアアース（希土類）、先端製造業を巡る戦略的な貿易政策の議論の一部に、今後一段と組み込まれていく可能性がある」と前出のゴエンカ氏は述べた。

中国が人工ダイヤモンド生産を急速に拡大したことで価格が下落し、生産者はより付加価値の高い用途を探る必要に迫られている。

フェン氏によると、粗利益率は宝石グレードのダイヤモンドが３０─４０％であるのに対し、工業用ダイヤモンドは約５０％だ。同氏は生産量をさらに増やすのではなく、より付加価値の高い工業用途に生産をシフトする計画だ。

人工ダイヤモンドの先端工業用途での利用が商業的に伸びる可能性は依然として不透明で、過剰生産能力が生じるリスクもあるが、生産者は楽観的な見方を崩していない。

「それは１０億元、あるいは１兆元規模の市場になる。われわれは従来型の用途を置き換えるため、次世代用途への戦略的な拡大を進めている」とフェン氏は語った。

items.title: Thousands evacuate India's eastern coast ahead of Cyclone Arnab
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Thousands of people were evacuated along India's eastern coast, and some train services cancelled, authorities said on Tuesday, one day before a severe cyclone was scheduled to make landfall, bringing gusting winds and heavy rain.
items.body:
Thousands of people were evacuated along India's eastern coast, and some train services cancelled, authorities said on Tuesday, one day before a severe cyclone was scheduled to make landfall, bringing gusting winds and heavy rain.
In neighbouring Nepal, authorities cautioned tourists against venturing into high altitude areas as they feared Cyclone Arnab could trigger torrential downpours, snowstorms and avalanches in the Himalayan region from Thursday night through Saturday.
The risks come at a time when the mountainous country is starting to recover from a [USN:L4N45R0T4 TEXT:"deadly flash flood"] in August, which killed about 1,500 people.
Arnab, which formed over the Bay of Bengal, has intensified since Monday, India's weather office said on Tuesday.
It is expected to make landfall in the southern coastal state of Andhra Pradesh by Wednesday morning, bringing strong winds and intense showers to parts of the state as well as neighbouring Odisha state.
Nearly 50,000 people had been moved to shelters from vulnerable areas by Monday night, out of 400,000 estimated to need evacuation, Prakhar Jain, Managing Director of Andhra Pradesh State Disaster Management Authority, told Reuters.
"Evacuation is continuing," Jain added.
There have been no evacuations in Odisha so far, Rajesh Prabhakar Patil, Special Relief Commissioner of Odisha, told Reuters. The state had already announced [USN:L3N46C07D TEXT:"closure of schools and colleges"] in five districts for Tuesday and Wednesday.
Televison showed waves crashing on deserted beaches and shuttered shops lining the streets along affected areas.
At least 12 trains were cancelled in the east, while rail services on 53 routes along the southern coast were suspended for Tuesday and Wednesday, regional railway authorities said in social media posts.
The Bay of Bengal is one of the world's major regions for tropical cyclones, which makes India's eastern coast particularly vulnerable to sea-linked weather disasters.

FAST

BEIJING: China's industrial profits grew at a faster pace in September, though a deepening divergence across the economy weighed on business earnings.
Profits at industrial firms rose 14.4 per cent from a year earlier last month, quickening from a 4.2 per cent increase in August, data from the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) showed on Tuesday (Oct 27). Profits were up 15.5 per in the first nine months of this year, largely unchanged from the 15.7 per cent increase in the January-August period.
The sectoral divide remained pronounced, with profits in the computer, communication and other electronic equipment manufacturing category more than doubling over the nine-month period, whereas profits in the furniture manufacturing sector fell by more than half, making it one of the worst performers.
Also casting a shadow over the sustainability of profit growth, export-oriented firms are bracing for greater uncertainty as expanding trade surpluses stoke tensions with trading partners, particularly Europe.

However, CITIC Bank International's chief China economist, Ding Meng, expressed optimism about the outlook because of the rapid growth in AI-related industries.
"This suggests that domestic and external demand generated by the development of the AI supply chain has become a key force supporting industrial profits," he said.
"Barring a major reversal in the global AI investment boom, industrial profits are expected to continue growing at a rapid pace."
A stronger-than-expected 4.5 per cent expansion in third-quarter GDP put China within reach of its annual growth target of 4.5 per cent to 5.0 per cent, but disparities across different parts of the economy suggest the recovery remains unbalanced, with persistent weakness in some sectors continuing to erode corporate profitability.
That pressure has become increasingly visible at the company level. Net profit growth at the world's largest electric vehicle battery maker, CATL, slowed sharply in the past quarter, as intense competition in the EV battery market squeezed margins at a time when China's auto sales were in a downturn.
China will continue to leverage macroeconomic policies to support growth, expand domestic demand and optimize supply, said NBS statistician Yu Weining, underscoring a push to replace traditional growth drivers with new ones.
Industrial profit figures cover firms with yearly revenue of at least 20 million yuan (US$3.0 million) from main operations.

items.title: アリババ、米国防総省の契約制限で仮差し止め命令獲得
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Eduardo Baptista　Preetika Parashuraman

[２６日 ロイター] - 米連邦地裁判事は２６日、アリババグループが求めていた仮差し止め命令を認め、同社のためにロビー活動を行う企業と取引があることを理由に、米政府がその企業や親会社、子会社に対して国防総省との契約を拒否しないよう命じた。

アリババは６月、国防総省が中国軍を支援しているとされる企業のリストに同社を追加したことを受け、米政府を提訴した。リストにはインターネット検索大手の百度（バイドゥ）、電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手の比亜迪（ＢＹＤ）など、中国の主要な製造業・テクノロジー企業も追加された。

２６日の判断により、アリババは国防総省の契約業者を顧客に持つ米ロビイストを引き続き起用できるようになる。これは、同社を「中国軍事企業」と指定した決定に異議を申し立てる取り組みにとって、障害となり得るものが取り除かれることを意味する。

この指定は正式な制裁を科すものではないが、国防総省と指定企業との契約を制限する。２０２７年からは第三者を通じた指定企業の製品やサービスの購入も制限する。

アリババは軍との関係を一切否定し、自社の製品やサービスは小売り、物流、企業向け技術を目的とするもので、防衛や情報活動向けではないとしている。

同社は６月に提出した訴状で「これらの判断には事実上も法律上も根拠がない」と主張し、リストからの除外を求めた。

２６日の仮差し止め命令は、アリババを国防総省のリストから除外するものではない。同社は指定を巡り、法廷で争い続けている。

items.title: How new UK finance minister's first budget could affect markets
items.author: Alun John, Samuel Indyk
items.creator: Alun John, Samuel Indyk
items.summary: Britain's new finance minister, John Healey, delivers his first budget on Wednesday against a backdrop of rising global borrowing costs and high energy prices due to the Iran war.
items.body:
Britain's new finance minister, [USN:L8N45X047 TEXT:"John Healey"], delivers his first budget on Wednesday against a backdrop of rising global borrowing costs and high energy prices due to the Iran war .
Budgets are typically a key event for [USN:L5N46B044 TEXT:"UK markets"], especially since 2022 when a former government's mini-budget and its plan for unfunded tax cuts sparked a bond market rout.
Since then, politicians have stressed fiscal discipline.
Here is a look at what is at stake for UK markets.
BOND SELLOFF STINGS A global bond selloff will add to the government's interest bill, eroding a [USN:L8N45V18B TEXT:"fiscal buffer"] that stood at £24 billion ($32 billion) in March.
Economists estimate it is down to between £8.5 billion and £20 billion.
Investors want reassurance over fiscal discipline, and they will watch [USN:L8N4682G5 TEXT:"borrowing plans"] for the coming 12 months announced after the budget.
Healey is under pressure to meet his fiscal rules without raising any of the main taxes.
Still, relative political stability, [USN:L8N4610AT TEXT:"better economic data"] and the Bank of England's decision to [USN:L8N4590W3 TEXT:"pause its gilt sales"] have lifted sentiment.
It also could be worse. Britain's 10-year borrowing costs are up almost 30 basis points to around 5.33% since the start of September. France's, while lower at 5.05%, have risen 86 bps. ,
"It's hard to be immune in an environment where global bond yields are going higher, but among major developed markets, the UK is looking like one of the cleanest dirty shirts out there," said Guillermo Felices, PGIM's global investment strategist.
STERLING SHRUGS Sterling, at a 17-month peak against the euro , appears unfazed.
Brighter [USN:ZRN00EPDT TEXT:"economic data"] has supported the pound, and FX options show little sign of traders seeking protection against budget-related drama.
"We are struck by the relative calm in UK markets," say BofA currency analysts. However, despite being long-standing sterling bulls, they have turned more cautious ahead of the budget, pointing to "some risks of complacency."
TAX THE BANKS? As the government looks for additional revenue to shore up its public finances without imposing broad tax rises, [USN:L6N45N0XP TEXT:"banks"] are sensitive to any signs that they could be targeted for a tax raid.
Media reports have said Healey plans to tax [USN:L8N4610PT TEXT:"banks"], potentially by increasing the 3% surcharge that banks pay on their profits.
Shares of the big four banks — HSBC (HSBA.L) , NatWest (NWG.L) , Lloyds (LLOY.L) and Barclays (BARC.L) — are down between 6% and 11% in October so far. While this is broadly in line with other European banks given [USN:L1N45N0S4 TEXT:"higher global borrowing costs"], pre-budget jitters are partly to blame.
"There's been commentary from the government that would lead you to conclude that they've decided the time is right to lean on banks a little more, and I wouldn't be surprised if there was a relatively neutral reaction," said Dominic Younger, portfolio manager for CT Progressive Income at Columbia Threadneedle.
He believed a move was now priced in.
SOME SINS ARE BETTER THAN OTHERS Gambling companies will be watching for a possible rise in the Machine Gaming Duty, a tax on the net takings from some fruit machines, slot machines and quiz machines.
The Times newspaper reported that the duty could rise by 5 percentage points to 25%, materially lower than a rise to 40% that a large group of ruling Labour Party politicians were pushing for. Shares in Entain (ENT.L) and Flutter Entertainment (FLUT.N) are both up about 10% in October.
[USN:L6N43P0CQ TEXT:"Pub chains"] have already seen a business rate cut and Prime Minister Andy Burnham's fondness for the sector may offer some hope that it escapes the worst of any tax rises.
"The prime minister has made it fairly clear that his affinity for the pub sector means he's not going to be layering costs on for them," said Columbia Threadneedle's Younger.
Recent strong trading updates from London-listed pub operators such as Wetherspoon (JDW.L) , Mitchells & Butlers (MAB.L) , Marston's (MARS.L) and Fuller Smith & Turner (FSTA.L) have pushed shares up between 10% and 25% this month.
BUDGET BOOST FOR BUILDERS? Housebuilder stocks (.FTNMX402020) surged in late September after the government confirmed plans for a new first-time buyer support scheme, boosting a sector battered by weak demand and affordability pressures.
"We believe this is the big catalyst the sector as a whole needed for a re-rating," said RBC analyst Anthony Codling after the plans were announced.
"Christmas has come early for the UK housebuilders."
But rising bond yields and mortgage rates have since acted as a headwind, with pre-budget share gains being almost completely wiped out.

items.body:
[東京 ２７日 ロイター] - 片山さつき財務相は２７日の参院財政金融委員会で、金利や為替相場はさまざまな要因を背景に市場において決まると述べた上で、「政府は市場の動向を高い緊張感を持って注視し、必要ならば断固とした措置を取るということでずっと注視している」と述べた。

円は過小評価ではないかという認識が日米首脳会談でも共有されているとし、為替相場は「ファンダメンタルズを反映した方向に本来いくべき」と指摘した。市場関係者を含めて「透明性高く一貫したコミュニケーション」を行うことで、市場の信認を確保していきたいと語った。

items.title: From Blackouts to Surplus: How Eskom Turned South Africa’s Power Around
items.summary: After enduring years of crippling power cuts, South Africa’s state utility Eskom has swung to an operational surplus, maintaining 3 to 5 gigawatts of excess generation capacity, according to CEO Dan Marokane. Yet across Johannesburg, localized outages persist as the city works to strengthen its finances and manage its power network. Speaking to Bloomberg’s Jennifer Zabasajja on Next Africa, Marokane discusses the city’s progress on settling overdue electricity bills and plans to ring-fence electricity revenue. He also outlines how Eskom’s recovery is enabling cross-border exports to neighboring southern African states, and explains why reliable electricity is central to rebuilding Johannesburg’s economy. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.author: ロイター

items.summary: ［２６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２６日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）のサンダーは２６日、ジェイレン・ウィリアムズが左腓骨骨折と足首の脱臼、ケイソン・ウォレスが左肩の関節唇断裂により、それぞれ手術を受けると発表した。両選手とも復帰時期は未定で、今季中の復帰が絶望となる可能性もある。

ウィリアムズは２５日に行われたクリッパーズ戦の第４クオーターで、ゴールに向かってドライブした際に相手選手のクリス・ダンから激しいファウルを受け、不自然な体勢で着地して負傷した。ウォレスも同じ試合で相手選手に接触して負傷した。

ウィリアムズは２０２４─２５年シーズンにオールスターとオールＮＢＡチームに選出されたが、昨季は手首の手術からの回復や度重なる太もも裏の負傷により、レギュラーシーズンの出場は３３試合にとどまり、プレーオフでもチームの１５試合のうち５試合しか出場できなかった。

ウォレスは昨季、オールディフェンシブ・セカンドチームに選出され、今季は開幕から３試合連続で先発出場していた。

FAST

HONG KONG: HSBC's third-quarter profit surged 32 per cent as it benefited from favourable interest rates while avoiding hefty credit losses, but a marked slowdown at its wealth business underscored the challenge of sustaining its recent strong performance.
The bank's Hong Kong-listed shares dropped 5 per cent after the results. They remain up 11 per cent for the year to date.
Pretax profit for Europe's largest bank came in at US$9.6 billion for the July-September quarter, in line with estimates compiled by HSBC.
It also launched a share buyback of up to US$1 billion, the same amount as the previous quarter.

On the plus side, HSBC benefited from the absence of legal provisions booked in the same quarter a year earlier. It also said expected credit losses tumbled 17 per cent to US$800 million, thanks to a reduction in charges linked to Hong Kong's real estate sector as well as its UK and Mexican wealth businesses.
But revenue for its wealth division was flat at US$2.7 billion. That compares with 15 per cent and 23 per cent year-on-year revenue growth in the first two quarters.
HSBC said it is on track to meet its core profitability targets through to 2028, in a further sign of how the region's lenders have sustained robust profits in recent years despite the impact of the Iran war on inflation and interest rates.
The strong performance has increased calls from activist groups in HSBC's home market of Britain for tax hikes on banks in Finance Minister John Healey's first budget, due on Wednesday.
Bank bosses have lobbied hard to avoid such an increase in sector levies, arguing it would curb lending and make Britain less competitive.
The bank clarified regulatory capital reforms known as Basel 3.1 would benefit its core capital ratio by up to half a percentage point, where previously the bank had described a 'modest benefit' from the reforms.
HSBC announced an interim dividend of US$0.1 per share, the same as the previous quarter.

FAST

TOKYO, Oct 27 : Japanese Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said on Tuesday the government stood ready to take decisive action in the currency market, suggesting Tokyo has not lowered its guard against persistent weakness in the yen.
"We are always watching market moves, including now, with a high sense of urgency," Katayama told parliament, when asked about the impact the administration's fiscal policy could have on the yen and long-term interest rate moves.
"If needed, we are ready to take decisive action," she said, adding that currencies should move in a way that reflects economic fundamentals.
The yen fell against the dollar on Tuesday to 157.73, slipping from the one-month high it touched last week.

The BOJ is set to keep interest rates steady at its policy meeting on Friday but signal its resolve to continue raising borrowing costs to prevent inflation from overshooting its 2 per cent target.
With the policy rate still low compared to other major central banks, the BOJ's hawkish tone has failed to reverse a downward trend in the yen that has become a headache for Japanese policymakers by pushing up the cost of imports.
Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's big spending plans have also been blamed by some analysts for triggering a selloff in the yen and Japanese government bonds (JGB) by stoking concern over the country's worsening finances.
Japan and the US carried out a rare joint yen-buying intervention on July 31, signalling their determination to prevent the decline in the yen and Japanese government bonds from spilling over into global markets.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [シンガポール ２７日 ロイター] - ＪＰモルガン・アセット・マネジメントのグローバル債券部門責任者、ボブ・マイケル...
items.body:
ＪＰモルガン幹部「債券買いの好機」、米で最大8％のリターン期待も
13:43 配信

米ドル紙幣。2026年3月24日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo（ロイター） [シンガポール ２７日 ロイター] - ＪＰモルガン・アセット・マネジメントのグローバル債券部門責任者、ボブ・マイケル氏は２７日、債券市場の利回りは「数十年に一度の水準」にあり、今が買い時だと述べた。米国では今後１年間で最大８％のリターンが期待できるという。

債券市場は、９月と１０月に特に先進国の国債が売り込まれた後、持ち直している。

マイケル氏はシンガポールで記者団に対し「フェデラルファンド（ＦＦ）金利と米国債の利回り曲線は、いずれも（４．５％前後に）収れんすると予想している」とした上で、「一般的に利上げサイクルの終わりには利回り曲線が平たんになる。従って、利回りには現行水準から動く余地が十分にある」と語った。

利息収入と債券価格の上昇により、米国市場では今後１２カ月間で７─８％のリターンが見込めるとした。

米１０年国債利回りは２７日、４．９９％前後で推移。過去数週間の大半は５％を上回る水準で推移した。

投資家は、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が２８日までの連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で、ＦＦ金利の誘導目標レンジを３．７５─４％に据え置くと予想している。

マイケル氏は「至る所で高い利回りが得られる」と指摘。「数週間前、米国債の利回り曲線が初めて５％を上回った際、われわれにとって買いのシグナルとなったのは、米国の実質利回りが３％に達したことだった。前回この水準を見たのは２００２年だ。約２５年ぶりの水準であり、買いの好機だ」と述べた。

有望な投資先として、日本やオーストラリアの債券、投資適格社債、新興国の国債などを挙げた。

一方、発生確率は低いものの影響が大きい「テールリスク」については、インフレ抑制のためにＦＲＢが政策金利を４．５％より大幅に高い水準まで引き上げる必要に迫られることだと述べた。

TOKYO, Oct 27 : Moody's sees encouraging signs in Japan's return to sustained growth and stable inflation, but a key test will be whether that resilience can withstand future shocks, the rating agency's Japan sovereign analyst told Reuters on Tuesday.
Moody's rates Japan at A1, its fifth-highest investment-grade rating, with a stable outlook, unchanged since its 2014 downgrade of Japan from Aa3.
"We're starting to see what looks more like sustained growth and inflation expectations that are reasonably well anchored around 2 per cent," said Martin Petch, a vice president at the sovereign risk group of Moody's Ratings.
"That's been something that's changed," Petch said in an interview, referring to a shift from decades of weak growth and chronically low inflation.

Petch declined to speculate on future rating actions, but said Moody's was watching to see if recent changes in Japan's economic and inflation environment prove sustainable, along with reforms that boost productivity and tackle demographic woes.
A key test, he added, is whether Japan can maintain growth and inflation stability through future economic shocks.
"You can generally tell when growth has become sustained when the economy has dealt with a shock," Petch said, pointing out that Japan had coped well with recent energy-price shocks while the central bank keeps up efforts to normalise policy.
LITTLE IMMEDIATE THREAT SEEN TO CREDIT PROFILE
Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's food sales tax cut and ambitious spending plans rattled bond markets this year, but Petch suggested the measures have posed little immediate threat to Japan's credit profile.
Their fiscal impact would depend on whether the government delivered on its pledge to offset the resulting revenue loss, he added.
Although ministries have sought a record 143 trillion yen ($908 billion) in initial spending requests, Petch said the rise was relatively modest compared with combined initial and supplementary budgets.
This reinforced Moody's view that there has been no meaningful departure from Japan's recent consolidation trend, he added.
But uncertainties hover over the government's 370-trillion-yen public-private investment initiative, Petch said.
These include the extent to which the private sector joins the initiative, and whether it can bring the productivity gains needed to offset Japan's demographic headwinds, he added.
($1=157.4700 yen)

items.title: IEA flags concentration of clean energy supply chains as emerging challenge
items.author: Siyi Liu, Florence Tan
items.creator: Siyi Liu, Florence Tan
items.summary: The concentration of a small number of countries in clean energy supply chains is an emerging challenge for Southeast Asian countries, International Energy Agency Executive Director Fatih Birol said on Tuesday, amid fast-rising power demand in the region.
items.body:
The concentration of a small number of countries in clean energy supply chains is an emerging challenge for Southeast Asian countries, International Energy Agency Executive Director Fatih Birol said on Tuesday, amid fast-rising power demand in the region.
"The age of electricity is coming. We will still use oil, still use natural gas including LNG, but electricity demand is growing very strongly," Birol told delegates at the Singapore International Energy Week conference.
Birol did not identify the countries dominating clean energy supplies, but China is by far the largest global supplier of renewable energy equipment, from solar panels to wind turbines, electric vehicles and batteries.
Electricity demand in ASEAN countries is rising at twice the pace of overall energy consumption, driven by industrial electrification, air-conditioning needs, electric vehicles and data centres, he said.
Southeast Asian nations have emerged as[USN:L1N3A320I TEXT:" key drivers of China's clean-energy export boom"], splashing out over $20 billion on Chinese-made clean-tech products so far in 2026, according to energy think tank Ember.
Birol also warned that geopolitical tensions have become an increasingly dominant force in global energy markets.
"In my professional life, I have never, never ever seen the dark and long shadow of geopolitics dominating the energy sector in such a way," he said. "I can only imagine that the role of geopolitics will be much more pronounced, and this means energy security is going to become even more important than it is today."
Birol said the Middle East war has triggered fundamental changes in global energy consumption patterns, spurring growth in solar, coal and nuclear power as well as electric vehicle adoption.
"I see in the last eight months very strong growth of electric car sales," he said, adding that global electric vehicle sales outside China had risen 60% above previous trends over the period because of the conflict.
Consumption of alternative energy sources has increased as diesel prices have jumped about 200% and LNG prices have risen 250% from pre-war levels, according to Birol.
He [USN:L2N46C04R TEXT:"said on Monday"] at the same conference that he does not expect energy markets in 2027 to return to where they were before the US-Israeli war on Iran began.

items.title: EU seeks to widen market access to counter trade restrictions, Germany's Merz says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz said on Tuesday that the European Union is seeking to collaborate more deeply on open market access to counter restrictions on global trade, including with Southeast Asia and members of the CPTPP trade pact.
items.body:
German Chancellor Friedrich Merz said on Tuesday that the European Union is seeking to collaborate more deeply on open market access to counter restrictions on global trade, including with Southeast Asia and members of the CPTPP trade pact.
The world is changing and the EU, with 450 million consumers, has become more active in seeking and building on partnerships to expand free trade with open competition, reliability and a rules-based order, Merz said during a visit to Singapore.
"This is a deliberate counterpoint to what we are currently seeing ... we want to do things differently and we want to show that there is a better way," Merz told a press conference
The Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership, or CPTPP, is a trade agreement comprising 12 countries, including Japan, Britain, Canada, Mexico, Australia, Singapore and Malaysia
Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong said his country, when it becomes chair of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations bloc in 2027, will push to make progress on an ASEAN-EU free trade deal
The EU has bilateral FTAs with several ASEAN countries and negotiations are ongoing with other ASEAN members
"We recognise that it will be challenging. It's complex, but we can also have some confidence in moving forward," Wong said about the ASEAN-EU agreement
Merz said he has called on the EU to better coordinate its existing bilateral trade frameworks with partners like Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia and India to "open up better opportunities for us and our businesses in the region"
He also said the EU would be willing to get involved in an ASEAN initiative to integrate its power grids and cooperate more on defence and security

items.title: HSBC shares tumble 6% after third-quarter revenue disappoints, wealth growth slows
items.author: Selena Li, Lawrence White
items.creator: Selena Li, Lawrence White
items.summary: HSBC's shares slid 6% on Tuesday after revenue undershot estimates and growth at its wealth business slowed, highlighting the challenge big banks face to sustain recent record profits.
items.body:
HSBC's shares slid 6% (HSBA.L) on Tuesday after revenue undershot estimates and growth at its wealth business slowed, highlighting the challenge big banks face to sustain recent record profits.
Europe's largest bank reported a 32% surge in pretax profit to $9.6 billion for the July-September quarter, in line with estimates. But investors and analysts focused on the lack of upgrades to the bank's performance guidance and underwhelming third-quarter revenue of $18.6 billion against forecasts for $19 billion.
The drop in the bank's shares underscores how recent strong results from European lenders have increased investor expectations for performance, even as the impact of the Iran war on inflation and interest rates has created a tough environment for banks. The shares remain up 9% for the year to date.
HSBC also launched a share buyback of up to $1 billion, the same amount as the previous quarter and a move that had boosted shares in previous reporting periods but is now largely expected by investors.
"There is sometimes a market expectation that we upgrade guidance or targets," CFO Pam Kaur told reporters on a conference call when asked about the share drop.
Analysts noted that the bank's net interest income slightly missed expectations, while fee income from its key wealth growth pillar was steady but unspectacular.
Escalating deposit competition in Hong Kong and the UK, HSBC's two core markets, are expected to push up interest expenses, they said. Time deposits in the bank's Hong Kong portfolio rose two percentage points quarter-on-quarter to 38%, but Jefferies analysts noted that the shift to chase higher deposits by offering higher interest rates is expected to erode margins.
Revenue for HSBC's wealth division was flat at $2.7 billion. That compared with 15% and 23% year-on-year revenue growth in the first two quarters.
The performance of HSBC's wealth business is under particular scrutiny because the British bank, like its peers, is focusing growth on fee-generating businesses such as wealth management as lending comes under pressure from falling interest rates.
Analysts warned that Asia-focused banks are bracing for a [USN:L3N46C09B TEXT:"slowdown in wealth momentum"] following robust gains driven by Chinese capital inflows.
Kaur said on the call that [USN:L4N45U04N TEXT:"China's tightening of wealth flows"] has prompted clients to shift from other banks in Hong Kong to HSBC.
"We picked up more business."
BRITAIN'S BANKS POISED FOR TAX HIKES HSBC benefited from the absence of legal provisions booked in the same quarter a year earlier. It also said expected credit losses tumbled 17% to $800 million, thanks to a reduction in charges linked to Hong Kong's real estate sector as well as its UK and Mexican wealth businesses.
British banks' strong recent results have prompted calls from trade unions and activist groups for tax hikes on the sector in finance minister John Healey's first budget, due on Wednesday.
Bank bosses have lobbied hard to avoid such an increase in sector levies, arguing it would curb lending and make Britain less competitive.
HSBC announced an interim dividend of $0.1 per share, the same as the previous quarter.

items.title: Alibaba wins injunction against Pentagon contract restrictions tied to China blacklist
items.author: Eduardo Baptista, Laurie Chen
items.creator: Eduardo Baptista, Laurie Chen
items.summary: A US federal judge on Monday granted Alibaba Group Holding's request for a preliminary injunction, ordering the US government not to deny Pentagon contracts to companies because they, their parent companies or subsidiaries do business with firms that engage in lobbying activities for the e-commerce giant.
items.body:
A US federal judge on Monday granted Alibaba Group Holding's (9988.HK) request for a preliminary injunction, ordering the US government not to deny Pentagon contracts to companies because they, their parent companies or subsidiaries do business with firms that engage in lobbying activities for the e-commerce giant.
Alibaba [USN:L1N42V0RB TEXT:"sued"] the US government in June after the Pentagon added it to a [USN:FWN42G12Z TEXT:"list of companies"] allegedly aiding China's military, alongside internet search provider Baidu, EV maker BYD and other major Chinese manufacturing and technology firms.
Monday's ruling means Alibaba will be able to retain US lobbyists who also represent Pentagon contractors, removing a potential obstacle to the company's efforts to challenge its designation as a Chinese military company.
Alibaba fired dozens of its Washington lobbyists after the Pentagon action in June, according to a source with direct knowledge of the matter who was not authorised to speak to the media.
The designation does not impose formal sanctions, but restricts Pentagon contracts with listed companies and, from 2027, purchases of their products or services through third parties.
Other listed Chinese tech firms were also concerned about the designation's impact on international lobbying activities as well as the indirect procurement ban, which would completely remove Chinese products from US defence contractors' supply chains, the source added.
Alibaba has denied any military ties, saying its products and services are built for retail, logistics, and enterprise technology rather than defence or intelligence.
"The determinations have no basis in fact or law," Alibaba said in its lawsuit in June, seeking its removal from the list.
Monday's injunction does not remove Alibaba from the Pentagon list, which the company is continuing to challenge in court.
Alibaba did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the injunction.
COMPANIES TAKE LEGAL ACTION Alibaba is one of several Chinese firms taking legal action to challenge their placement on the Pentagon's list.
Last month, two subsidiaries of the world's largest electric vehicle maker BYD (002594.SZ) sued the US Department of Defence over a federal law banning any Pentagon contractors from hiring lobbyists that also work with blacklisted firms, arguing that it breached BYD's First Amendment rights.
In August, DJI, the world's largest drone maker, [USN:L6N44B0VR TEXT:"appealed"] its inclusion on the blacklist with the court finding merit in its argument that unclassified records did not support the conclusion that the company contributed to the Chinese defence industrial base.
The appeals court ordered the lower court to reconsider its decision to reject DJI's bid to be removed from the Pentagon list and the case is ongoing.
The same month, biotech firm WuXi AppTec Co (603259.SS) also won a preliminary [USN:L1N4440V2 TEXT:"injunction"] from a US federal court, which blocked its inclusion on the list. WuXi said the Pentagon designation was politically motivated.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Summer Zhen　Selena Li

［香港　２６日　ロイター］ - 英金融大手ＨＳＢＣホールディングスが、傘下...
items.body:
英ＨＳＢＣ、傘下ファンド事業統合へ　恒生銀行の事業吸収＝関係筋
12:41 配信

香港の金融街にあるHSBC本社ビルで2020年8月4日撮影　 REUTERS/Tyrone Siu（ロイター） Summer Zhen　Selena Li

［香港　２６日　ロイター］ - 英金融大手ＨＳＢＣホールディングスが、傘下の恒生銀行（ハンセン銀行）の資産運用部門を自社のファンド事業に統合する。事情に詳しい関係者２人が２６日明らかにした。

関係者によると、ＨＳＢＣアセット・マネジメント（運用資産約８７６０億ドル）が、恒生投資管理（ハンセン・インベストメント・マネジメント）（同約５００億ドル）を吸収する計画。

ＨＳＢＣはロイターへの電子メール声明で、香港市場で競争力を高めるため、資産運用事業の規模や人材、成長戦略の強化を目指していると述べたが、資産運用部門の統合計画についてはコメントを控えた。

「将来の成長機会を引き出すため、各チーム間の連携に注力している」とした上で、恒生銀行については独立した銀行免許を持つ銀行として維持すると改めて説明した。

恒生銀行はロイターのコメント要請に応じていない。

ＨＳＢＣは２０２５年１０月、恒生銀行の買収・非公開化に向けた手続きを開始。買収総額は１３６億ドルで、取引は２６年１月に完了した。

今回の統合が実現すれば、両行のブランドを独立して維持するとの従来方針の下で進められてきた経営体制において、初の事業部門レベルの統合となる。

恒生銀行は、香港の代表的株価指数であるハンセン指数に連動する上場投資信託（ＥＴＦ）「トラッカー・ファンド・オブ・ホンコン」を運営している。同ファンドは香港最大のＥＴＦで、香港の公的年金制度である強制積立基金（ＭＰＦ）における主要投資商品にもなっている。

items.author: ロイター

Miho Uranaka

[東京 ２７日 ロイター] - 米ＡＩ（人工知能）開発のアンソロピックは２６日、米国での新規...
items.body:
アンソロピックＩＰＯ、みずほ・ＭＵＦＧも幹事証券　日本でも販売へ
12:37 配信

ニューヨーク証券取引所で、アンソロピックの新規株式公開に関するニュースが表示されている　2026年10月26日撮影　REUTERS/Jeenah Moon（ロイター） Miho Uranaka

[東京 ２７日 ロイター] - 米ＡＩ（人工知能）開発のアンソロピックは２６日、米国での新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）に向けた申請書類（Ｓ－１）を公開した。幹事証券団には、みずほフィナンシャルグループと三菱ＵＦＪフィナンシャル・グループ（ＭＵＦＧ）傘下の証券会社が並んだ。アンソロピックは、日本での資金調達を実施する方向だ。

みずほは英半導体設計大手アームや宇宙開発企業スペースＸ 、ＰａｙＰａｙの米国上場でも幹事を務めた実績がある。現在ＩＰＯの準備を進めているＳＢエナジーでは、みずほに加えてＭＵＦＧも幹事に名を連ねている。

アンソロピックは、日本を含む米国外でも公募を行う方針で、今後、日本での公募に向けて関東財務局に届出書を提出する見通し。主幹事はゴールドマン・サックスとモルガン・スタンレーが務める。

ロイターは、アンソロピックが最近の投資家向けイベントで財務情報の一部を開示した後、既存株主や出資を検討する投資家の一部が同社の評価額を約１兆５０００億ドルと見積もっていると報じていた。  

Ｓ－１書類によると、巨額の赤字と急速な売上高の伸びが明らかになった。アンソロピックの２０２６年上期の純損失は８０７億ドルと大幅に拡大した。主に、転換社債の公正価値が上昇したことが響いた。同期の売上高は約１６３億ドルだった。６月３０日までの３カ月間の売上高は、前年同期比１３６８％増と急増した。開発に多額の費用がかかる中でも、世界経済を変革し得るＡＩシステムの構築を目指す姿勢を示した。

items.title: Jackson Chourio, Brewers blitz Rays in Game 3, close in on Series sweep
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: ST. PETERSBURG, Fla. -- The Milwaukee Brewers benefited from an offensive barrage with two outs in the fifth inning to move within one win of the first World Series title in franchise history.
items.body:
ST. PETERSBURG, Fla. -- The Milwaukee Brewers benefited from an offensive barrage with two outs in the fifth inning to move within one win of the first World Series title in franchise history.
Jackson Chourio highlighted his four-hit performance with an RBI double to cap an eight-run fifth inning, fueling Milwaukee to a 10-1 romp over the Tampa Bay Rays on Monday as the Brewers took a 3-1 lead in the Fall Classic.
Chourio is 8-for-14 with four runs in the first three contests of the World Series.
The Brewers, who are 10-1 in the postseason, will look to capture their first World Series title in Game 4 on Tuesday in St. Petersburg.
Milwaukee recorded 16 hits to provide more than enough offense for Robert Gasser (1-0), who allowed one hit -- Yandy Diaz's single to lead off the first -- over six scoreless innings. He walked one and struck out three to become the first left-hander to face the minimum 18 batters through six innings of a World Series game since Hall of Famer Sandy Koufax accomplished the feat for the Los Angeles Dodgers in 1965.
Gasser has yielded one run on seven hits in 15 innings over three outings in the postseason.
"It was a great team win, but we've got work to do," Gasser told Fox Sports. "There's still one more game to go."
The Brewers broke open the game in the fifth after a replay review overturned a call at second base in which a hustling Christian Yelich initially was called out to end the inning.
"The whole game was changed when Yeli was safe at second, that's a hustle play," Milwaukee manager Pat Murphy said. "When your leader makes that play, that says it all."
Instead, Milwaukee had the bases loaded, and the Brewers turned a 2-0 game into a 10-0 laugher when each of the next six batters reached base.
Cam Booser relieved Freddy Peralta (2-1) and promptly permitted a sharp single by Brice Turang that caromed off the glove of shortstop Taylor Walls and into shallow center field, allowing Chourio and Yelich to score.
Garrett Mitchell added an RBI single to left field, Cooper Pratt bounced a two-run double over the third base bag, and Sal Frelick delivered an RBI double to extend the Brewers' lead to 8-0.
That chased Booser, but David Hamilton greeted Cole Sulser with an RBI single and Chourio added a run-scoring double to push Milwaukee's advantage to 10-0.
"Afterward, it's just a credit to the guys just passing the baton to each other," Yelich said. "We were able to have good AB after good AB, and we were able to lengthen it out there."
Tampa Bay manager Kevin Cash naturally sang a different tune.
"It's definitely deflating, how can it not be?" Cash said of the inning.
Chourio singled off Peralta with one out in the third inning, advanced to second on a walk by Jake Bauers and opened the scoring on Yelich's single to left field.
Milwaukee doubled the advantage on the next pitch when William Contreras singled to right field. Victor Mesa Jr. briefly bobbled the ball, allowing Bauers to score from second base.
Peralta permitted five runs on seven hits in 4 2/3 innings against the team with which he spent the first eight seasons of his major league career.
Diaz had an RBI double in the ninth inning off Brewers veteran Brandon Woodruff, who hadn't pitched since July 4 due to a shoulder injury.
--Field Level Media

items.body:
日英伊戦闘機開発、エアバスが参加模索か　ＢＡＥと協議予定と英紙
12:25 配信

2026年2月6日、フランスのマルセイユ近郊、マリニャーヌにあるエアバス・ヘリコプターズの工場で、エアバスのロゴが見られる。 REUTERS/Manon Cruz（ロイター） ［２５日　ロイター］ - 欧州航空機大手エアバスが、日英伊官民の次世代戦闘機共同開発への参画を模索しているもようだ。英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）は２５日、エアバスの幹部が参画に向けて英防衛大手ＢＡＥシステムズと協議する見通しだと報じた。

ＧＣＡＰは２０３５年までの開発を目指しており、企業ではＢＡＥ、三菱重工業、イタリアのレオナルドが参画している。

エアバスの広報担当者はロイターに対し「エアバスは、ドイツ、スペインおよび欧州の産業界が開発、生産、運用で実質的かつ対等な参加を認められることを条件に、協力することに原則として前向きだ」とコメントした。

ＢＡＥはコメント要請に応じなかった。

ＦＴによると、エアバスとＢＡＥは自律型の「協調戦闘機」などでの協力についても話し合う見通しだ。また、戦闘機やドローン（無人機）、地上レーダーなどのセンサーの間でデータ交換を可能にするデジタル基盤「コンバットクラウド」も協業分野になり得るとしている。

バーナム英首相は今月、英国がドイツのＧＣＡＰ参加に前向きな見解を示していた。カナダは７月にＧＣＡＰへのオブザーバー参加を表明しており、サウジアラビアも参加に関心を示していると伝えられてきた。

items.title: Judge extends block on Trump plans to renovate Washington golf course
items.author: Kanishka Singh
items.creator: Kanishka Singh
items.summary: A US judge extended on Monday a court order blocking President Donald Trump's plans to renovate a historic Washington golf course where she had deemed a removal of trees "inexcusable".
items.body:
A US judge extended on Monday a court order blocking President Donald Trump's plans to renovate a [USN:L6N46503C TEXT:"historic Washington golf course"] where [USN:L1N45Y0L4 TEXT:"she had deemed"] a removal of trees "inexcusable".
The renovation, at the center of a lawsuit over environmental and historic preservation concerns, is one of the projects Trump is pursuing to reshape landmarks in the US capital.
"The court still does not speak for the trees," US District Judge Ana Reyes said in her order filed in the district court for the District of Columbia, adding, "It speaks only for the rule of law."
Her order barred the government from "removing or damaging additional trees" on the course.
It also ordered the government to provide 10 business days of written advance notice before it makes any "irreparable modification" at the park, pending the suit outcome.
Trump said in an online post late on Monday the government would appeal the decision and that his administration would close "the East Potomac Golf Course Site as scheduled on November 15th in order to renovate and rebuild."
Two weeks earlier, Reyes faulted the conduct of Justice Department lawyers in the lawsuit seeking to halt the Trump administration's takeover of the historic golf course.
It was "inexcusable" that hundreds of trees were removed from the course during the prior weekend, she added.
Last week Trump said his administration [USN:L6N46503C TEXT:"would begin renovation"] work immediately, despite the judge's order that work could not proceed without prior notice to the court. Trump had also attacked the judge by calling her a "lunatic."
The DC Preservation League sued in February to halt the takeover, on the grounds that it would violate environmental laws and "irreparably destroy a priceless piece of American history."
Reyes said the government had asked her to disregard Trump's statements about the renovation plans.
"Rarely, if ever, has the United States Department of Justice urged a federal court not to believe the sitting president," Reyes said.
"This started as a case about golf ... But it has become much more," she added.
"It now forces the court to reconcile assertions by President Donald J. Trump with the sworn testimony of multiple government employees and the argument of senior DOJ attorneys."

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Fumiya Mizuno

[東京 ２７日 ロイター] - 前場の東京株式市場で日経平均は反発し、前営業日比１．９２％...
items.body:
午前の日経平均は反発、ＡＩ・半導体株を物色　中盤から伸び悩む
12:01 配信

写真は2024年12月、都内の東京証券取引所で撮影。 REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon（ロイター） Fumiya Mizuno

[東京 ２７日 ロイター] - 前場の東京株式市場で日経平均は反発し、前営業日比１．９２％（１１９１円６４銭）高の６万３３８１円２９銭となった。米ハイテク株上昇の流れを受けて、ＡＩ（人工知能）・半導体関連株が幅広く物色されて戻り歩調を鮮明にし、前営業日比で一時２．４％（１４９５円０４銭）高の６万３６８４円６９銭まで上昇。ただ、日米欧で金融政策決定会合を控えるうえ、ここから始まる米ハイパースケーラーや国内主要企業の決算を見極めたいとされ、中盤からは伸び悩んだ。

・米アンソロピックの新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）申請を受け、米国でハイテク株が上昇した流れが東京市場にも波及。

・ＡＩ・半導体関連株が全体の上昇を先導。ＫＯＳＰＩの上昇も追い風となる。

・米ハイパースケーラー、国内ＡＩ関連企業の決算を見極めたいとのムードがあり、後場は伸び悩む可能性も。

・ＴＯＰＩＸは０．５８％高の３９９６．１７ポイントで午前の取引を終了。東証プライム市場の売買代金は３兆４０２１億０４００万円。

・東証３３業種では、値上がりは電気機器、非鉄金属など１３業種、値下がりは不動産業、医薬品、陸運業など２０業種。

・個別では、アドバンテスト、キオクシアホールディングス、東京エレクトロンなどが上昇。半面、リクルートホールディングス、第一三共などがさえない。

・東証プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がりが７０２銘柄（４５％）、値下がりは８０２銘柄（５１％）、変わらずは４７銘柄（３％）。

＜野村証券　ストラテジスト　秋山渉氏＞

「ＡＩ・半導体関連の好材料によって市場の雰囲気は落ち着きを取り戻した。原油価格がやや低下したことも好材料になる」

「日経平均の寄与度上位はＡＩ・半導体株が占め、一極集中とまでは言わないものの、これらが上昇をリードしているのは確かだ」

「日米欧はいずれも利上げ見送りで織り込んでおり、目先的に相場の方向性を決めるのは米ハイパースケーラーの決算となりそうだ」

items.title: Rupee boxed in range; traders focus on oil, outflows and RBI's defence
items.author: Dharamraj Dhutia
items.creator: Dharamraj Dhutia
items.summary: The Indian rupee seesawed in a narrow range against the dollar on Tuesday before ending little changed, while underlying sentiment remained weak.
items.body:
The Indian rupee seesawed in a narrow range against the dollar on Tuesday before ending little changed, while underlying sentiment remained weak.
The rupee ended at 95.1150 per dollar, up less than 0.1% from 95.1850 on Monday.
Persistent external pressures from higher oil prices and equity outflows have left the currency reliant on Reserve Bank of India intervention for support, traders said.
India should not "fixate on a number" for its currency level or run down foreign exchange reserves to defend the rupee, former Reserve Bank of India governor [USN:L6N46D0A3 TEXT:"Raghuram Rajan"], told Reuters on Tuesday. The central bank has [USN:L1N461073 TEXT:"spent around $80 billion"] to bolster the local currency since June.
Benchmark Brent crude oil was hovering close to its highest levels in the last six months, around $117 per barrel in Asian hours, pushing importers to increase their hedging bets.
India relies on imports for around 90% of its oil requirements. High prices add to concerns over Asia's third largest economy's outlook, with implications for foreign portfolio outflows and the nation's current account balance.
Foreign investors have net sold around $8.5 billion of Indian equities in the last two months, a major drag on the rupee.
Equity market volatility, currency concerns and the return on offer from dollar-denominated fixed income investments are encouraging investors to reassess equity-concentrated portfolios, said Sachin Sawrikar, Managing Partner at GIFT City-based Artha Bharat Investment Managers.
Meanwhile, traders said elevated US Treasury yields have also been putting pressure on the local currency, as investors are not able to find a decent carry for their investments risks.
Viram Shah, CEO at fintech company Vested, said with the 10-year US yield around 5%, fixed-income instruments have become more relevant for investors.
Traders said the central bank's tolerance for a measured weakening in the rupee would be closely watched in the near-term.
The RBI's intervention, along with [USN:L1N45W00Y TEXT:"measures"] to curb dollar buying helped the local currency recover earlier this month after it neared a record low hit in May.

items.summary: [ロンドン ２７日 ロイター] - 英小売協会（ＢＲＣ）が２７日発表した１０月の小売価格は前年同月比２．１％上昇した。...
items.body:
英小売価格、10月は前年比＋2.1％　2年半超ぶり上昇率＝ＢＲＣ
11:37 配信

写真は3月27日、英ロンドンで撮影。 REUTERS/Jaimi Joy（ロイター） [ロンドン ２７日 ロイター] - 英小売協会（ＢＲＣ）が２７日発表した１０月の小売価格は前年同月比２．１％上昇した。上昇率は９月の１．４％から加速し、２０２４年２月以来の大きさとなった。

ＢＲＣは、小売業者がコスト上昇の影響を吸収することが次第に困難になっていると警告した。

ＢＲＣのヘレン・ディキンソン最高責任者は「小売業者はこの２年間、押し寄せる大幅なコスト増を吸収してきたが、その防波堤が決壊し始めている」と述べた上で、ヒーリー財務相に対し、２８日に発表する就任後初の年次予算案で小売業者の不動産税負担と雇用コストを軽減するよう求めた。

１０月の食品価格上昇率は２．９％と、９月の２．５％から加速し、４月以来の高水準となった。常温食品の価格上昇率は３．２％と、９月の２．２％から加速し、２５年９月以来の高水準。

非食品の価格上昇率は１．７％と、０．８％から加速し、２３年１２月以来の高水準となった。家具、床材、住宅改修用品の価格が特に大きく上昇した。

イングランド銀行（中央銀行）のベイリー総裁は今月、２２年のロシアによるウクライナ侵攻後と異なり、これまでのところ、米国とイランの戦争に伴うエネルギーコストの上昇を企業がおおむね吸収しており、利上げの必要性が低下していると述べていた。

items.title: Indian equity benchmarks muted as elevated oil, Fed in focus
items.author: Vivek M, Bharath Rajeswaran
items.creator: Vivek M, Bharath Rajeswaran
items.summary: Indian equity benchmarks ended little changed on Tuesday as elevated oil prices kept sentiments cautious, with investors awaiting the Federal Reserve's policy decision later this week.
items.body:
Indian equity benchmarks ended little changed on Tuesday as elevated oil prices kept sentiments cautious, with investors awaiting the Federal Reserve's policy decision later this week.
The Nifty 50 (.NSEI) fell 0.02% to 22,749.75, and the Sensex (.BSESN) shed 0.01% to 73,598.67.
Brent crude traded near $116 per barrel, close to six-month high levels, as attacks on Saudi Arabia dampened hopes of an immediate easing of regional tensions.
India's broader small-caps (.NIFSMCP100) and mid-caps (.NIFMDCP100) rose 2.7% and 1%, respectively.
Gains there were driven by a post-earnings jump in [USN:L3N46D09D TEXT:"Sona BLW"] (SONB.NS) , [USN:L3N46D0CV TEXT:"Ather Energy"] (ATHR.NS) and [USN:L3N46D0AO TEXT:"Mankind Pharma"] (MNKI.NS) , and buying in [USN:L3N46D0HU TEXT:"defence"] stocks after the acquisition panel's clearance of over $22 billion worth of proposals.
Twelve of the 16 major sectors logged gains.
Investors' focus this week is on the [USN:L6N46606V TEXT:"Fed"], which is expected to keep rates steady on Wednesday, before resuming its tightening cycle in December as inflation worries loom.
"A hawkish stance could keep global financial conditions tight, weigh on emerging-market flows and create near-term volatility," said Thomas Priju, portfolio manager at Karma Capital.
The Nifty 50 has lost about 13% so far in 2026, on course for its worst performance in over a decade as soaring crude oil prices fueled by the Middle East war and a [USN:L4N45V07Q TEXT:"lack of large AI exposure"] have propelled record foreign outflows.
As the world's third-largest crude oil importer, India is particularly vulnerable to higher oil prices, which intensify inflationary pressures, strain the fiscal balance, and squeeze corporate profitability.
Heavyweight financials (.NIFTYFIN) and information technology stocks (.NIFTYIT) fell 0.6% and 0.3%, while auto (.NIFTYAUTO) and pharma stocks (.NIPHARM) rose 1.5% and 1.9%.
[USN:L3N46C0SM TEXT:"Tata Consumer Products"] (TACN.NS) rose 6.8% after reporting better-than-expected second-quarter profit, helped by steady demand for its packaged foods and beverages as the company expands beyond traditional tea and salt businesses.

items.body:
Pakistan’s press freedom worsens as journalists unite against censorship, legal harassment Senior journalists, media unions, political figures and civil society representatives in Pakistan have formed a joint alliance to defend press freedom amid growing concerns over censorship, legal intimidation, financial insecurity and restrictions on digital communication, as reported by Geo News.
ANI | Updated: 27-10-2026 14:53 IST | Created: 27-10-2026 14:53 IST

Representative Image (File Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Senior journalists, media unions, political figures and civil society representatives in Pakistan have formed a joint alliance to defend press freedom amid growing concerns over censorship, legal intimidation, financial insecurity and restrictions on digital communication, as reported by Geo News. According to Geo News, the decision emerged from a roundtable moderated by journalist Munizae Jahangir and chaired by veteran journalist Nasir Zaidi, where participants called for coordinated efforts to protect freedom of expression and expand civic space. Speakers proposed documenting violations and examining the role of political parties in passing restrictive laws. Prominent anchor Hamid Mir cited cases registered under the Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act (PECA), including those against journalists, and proposed a white paper detailing restrictions on free speech.
Veteran journalist Mujeebur Rehman Shami argued that Pakistan’s problem extended beyond legislation to the ineffective implementation of existing laws. Najam Sethi criticised political parties for failing to safeguard fundamental rights, warning that self-censorship and commercial pressures had weakened independent journalism. Asma Shirazi highlighted online harassment targeting women journalists, while Arifa Noor stressed the need to systematically document censorship and abuses against media workers. Journalists representing Balochistan, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Punjab, Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir (PoJK) and Pakistan-occupied Gilgit-Baltistan (PoGB) described mounting security threats and economic pressures. KP journalist leader Nasir Hussain highlighted the killings of more than 30 journalists in the province since 9/11 and said 22 journalists faced threats in 2025. He also cited restrictive legislation proposed by the provincial assembly, which was withdrawn after protests, as reported by Geo News.
Former senator Farhatullah Babar urged the alliance to engage political parties directly and demand safeguards against surveillance and misuse of personal data. Meanwhile, journalists’ representatives criticised PECA amendments, defamation laws and delayed salaries, arguing that these measures had further weakened press freedom, as reported by Geo News. (ANI)

SEOUL, Oct 27 : South Korea's semiconductor exports could fall by $50 billion to $100 billion compared with earlier forecasts if capital spending on artificial intelligence by major US technology firms slows next year, according to central bank data.
In a written response submitted to lawmaker Ahn Do-geol, the Bank of Korea (BOK) modelled a "pessimistic scenario" to assess the economic fallout if US tech giants curb their aggressive infrastructure outlays.
Under the scenario, a sudden export shortfall would shave approximately 0.4 per centage point off South Korea's gross domestic product (GDP) growth rate next year, by driving the country's current account surplus well below the central bank's initial projection of $430 billion for 2027.
The scenario assumed a 10 per cent decline in Korean semiconductor unit prices.

The report said combined capital expenditure by five major US technology firms, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Meta, and Oracle, has been growing rapidly, from $40 billion last year to an estimated $80 billion this year, and is projected to reach $110 billion next year.
However, the BOK cautioned that considerable uncertainty remains over the trajectory of AI demand and the broader memory chip business cycle.

items.title: Dollar firms ahead of central bank meetings, steadier stocks stall safe haven play
items.author: Alun John
items.creator: Alun John
items.summary: The dollar nudged higher on the euro, yen and pound on Tuesday, as traders braced for a barrage of major central bank meetings that will shape the interest rate outlook, as well as key corporate earnings that could ripple through all asset classes.
items.body:
The dollar nudged higher on the euro, yen and pound on Tuesday, as traders braced for a barrage of major central bank meetings that will shape the interest rate outlook, as well as key corporate earnings that could ripple through all asset classes.
The Federal Reserve is set to announce its latest policy decision on Wednesday, the European Central Bank is up on Thursday, and the Bank of Japan rounds out the week on Friday.
All three are expected to keep rates on hold, so the focus will be on any hints policymakers give on their outlook.
Also helping the dollar, especially on safe havens like the yen and Swiss franc, was greater calm in the equity market which was roiled last week by renewed worries about high-flying AI stocks.
"The dollar has found good support early this week, as stabilising AI-related sentiment has allowed markets to reconnect with the broader supportive backdrop of a hawkish Federal Reserve and high energy prices," said Francesco Pesole, currency analyst at ING.
The US currency was up 0.16% on the yen at 157.73 , while the euro slid 0.17% to $1.1154 and the pound dipped 0.14% to $1.3324.
Pesole also said he thought markets were positioning ahead of the Fed meeting, anticipating Chair Kevin Warsh will reiterate his commitment to fighting inflation, something that will reinforce the floor under the dollar.
Several other factors are in the mix as well and a key gauge of Japan's service-sector inflation [USN:L3N46D002 TEXT:"rose"] 3.7% in September from a year earlier, data showed on Tuesday, a sign of increasing price pressures that will likely keep the central bank on track for further interest rate hikes.
Also in Japan, Finance Minister [USN:L2N46D03K TEXT:"Satsuki Katayama "]said on Tuesday the government stood ready to take decisive action in the currency market, reminding markets of Tokyo's willingness to intervene to prop up its currency.
TECH EARNINGS IMPACT The broader market story will also be tested by a number of corporate earnings this week including from AI hyperscalers Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , Microsoft (MSFT.O) and Amazon.com (AMZN.O) .
The yen was among the best-performing major currencies last week, strengthening around 0.75% on the dollar, its most since early September, as AI jitters in the equity market spurred a rush into the currency.
Meanwhile, the euro was on track to be the worst-performing developed market currency in October, down 1.5% on the dollar, bruised by high energy costs, and the volatility in French government bonds and worries about France's fiscal position.
The [USN:L6N4690QQ TEXT:"Reserve Bank of New Zealand"] and the Bank of Canada also announce their policy decisions on Wednesday, with both expected to raise interest rates.
The RBNZ meets on Wednesday, and the New Zealand dollar was outperforming ahead of that, up 0.1% on the dollar on Tuesday at $0.5687.
The Canadian dollar was steady at $1.4021 to its US counterpart .

items.title: Russia, Ukraine begin Oleshky ceasefire but keep up strikes elsewhere
items.author: Jekaterina Golubkova
items.creator: Jekaterina Golubkova
items.summary: Russia and Ukraine have begun a regional ceasefire to allow the start of a humanitarian effort in the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky, but they continue strikes elsewhere, including the Ukrainian capital of Kyiv.
items.body:
Russia and Ukraine have begun a regional ceasefire to allow the start of a humanitarian effort in the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky, both sides said on Tuesday, but they continue strikes elsewhere, including the Ukrainian capital of Kyiv.
The [USN:L1N46911P TEXT:"ceasefire"] should enable deliveries of aid as well as evacuations from the frontline town in southern Ukraine that is grappling with acute shortages of food and medicine.
"As head of the Ukrainian negotiating team, I confirm that the Ukrainian side is honouring its commitments," Dmytro Lubinets, the parliamentary commissioner for human rights, said in a Facebook post confirming Russia's timing of its halt.
On Telegram, Russia's defence ministry said it stopped shelling in the direction of Ukraine's city of Kherson from 4 a.m. Moscow time (0100 GMT), to prepare for the effort in Oleshky, which faces Kherson across the Dnipro River.
Lubinets added that the deal was reached in coordination with US First Lady Melania Trump in cooperation with Russia's commissioner for human rights, Yana Lantratova.
NEW STRIKES ON KYIV FORCE TRAFFIC HALT New strikes on Tuesday hit the Southern Bridge and subway infrastructure in Kyiv, forcing a suspension of traffic, city officials [USN:P8N44K01G TEXT:"said"], while a Reuters witness heard explosions.
Oleshky [USN:L2N46C0BA TEXT:"lies"] on the eastern bank of the Dnipro in Ukraine's southern region of Kherson, opposite the city of Kherson, which is held by Ukrainian forces.
But Russian troops have controlled the town since seizing it during the first days of their February 2022 invasion.
White House envoys have [USN:L1N4690TJ TEXT:"talked"] to both sides in recent days to try and find a solution as the US looks to mediate a peace deal to end the war, Europe's deadliest conflict since the World War Two.
On Friday, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said peace negotiators from Ukraine, Russia and the United States had agreed to meet at a technical level in the first half of November in Abu Dhabi to continue the talks.
FRESH ATTACKS A Russian missile [USN:L2N46C0Y8 TEXT:"attack"] on Kyiv killed at least one and injured 15, including students in a dormitory, since Monday evening. The attacks [USN:L2N46C0SM TEXT:"also"] killed and injured people in the cities of Kharkiv and Pavlohrad.
On the Telegram messaging app, the Russian defence ministry said it has hit transport infrastructure in Kyiv, a logistics hub in the Kharkiv region as well as industrial facilities and cargo vessels elsewhere it cited as being put to military use.
A drone attack [USN:P8N44K01I TEXT:"killed"] a man and wounded six people in the western Russian city of Bryansk close to the border with Ukraine.
Another person was killed and 30 [USN:P8N44K01H TEXT:"injured"] as a drone hit a bus in the Russian-controlled part of Ukraine's southeastern region of Zaporizhzhia, local officials said.
Reuters could not immediately independently verify the reports. Russia and Ukraine deny deliberately targeting civilians.

items.summary: Residents of Rawalpindi are facing prolonged electricity outages lasting six to eight hours, with the Islamabad Electric Supply Company (IESCO) disconnecting power without adequate prior notice, as ...
items.body:
Pakistan: Rawalpindi faces hours of unannounced, frustrating load-shedding Residents of Rawalpindi are facing prolonged electricity outages lasting six to eight hours, with the Islamabad Electric Supply Company (IESCO) disconnecting power without adequate prior notice, as reported by Dawn.
ANI | Updated: 27-10-2026 14:17 IST | Created: 27-10-2026 14:17 IST

Representative Image (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Residents of Rawalpindi are facing prolonged electricity outages lasting six to eight hours, with the Islamabad Electric Supply Company (IESCO) disconnecting power without adequate prior notice, as reported by Dawn. According to Dawn, despite the arrival of colder weather, load-shedding continues to disrupt daily life. IESCO maintains that it is implementing two hours of daily load management to address the gap between electricity demand and supply. However, residents have complained that repeated maintenance shutdowns and unscheduled outages are worsening their difficulties. Muhammad Awais, a resident of Faisal Colony, said electricity remained unavailable for six hours, from 8 am to 2 pm, on Thursday before another shutdown took place on Monday without advance information. He said students, office workers and women managing household responsibilities were particularly affected, demanding that consumers be notified at least a day before planned outages.
Muhammad Farhan of Shah Khalid Colony also criticised the prolonged shutdowns, saying residents were informed only after contacting the utility. He stated that monthly electricity bills exceeding Rs10,000 were placing additional pressure on household budgets despite relatively low consumption. Residents of other localities have raised similar concerns. Suhail Raja of Media Town said power cuts frequently occurred in the evenings and late at night. When he contacted IESCO's complaint centre, he was reportedly told that the Pakistan Electric Power Company (PEPCO) was carrying out the unscheduled outages. Abdur Rehman, a resident of Dhoke Ratta, criticised the government over the worsening situation, warning that public frustration could have political consequences. Traders have also reported financial losses as businesses struggle to operate without electricity, with shopkeepers forced to use generators to keep their premises illuminated, as highlighted by Dawn.
Responding to the complaints, Iesco spokesperson Raja Asim said annual maintenance work had begun on transformers, feeders, transmission lines and other electrical infrastructure across the region between Attock and Jhelum, as reported by Dawn. (ANI)

items.title: European shares dip as HSBC results weigh on banks ahead of Big Tech earnings
items.author: Johann Cherian, Ankur Banerjee
items.creator: Johann Cherian, Ankur Banerjee
items.summary: European shares slipped on Tuesday, dragged down by banking stocks, after disappointing results from HSBC, while investors also turned cautious ahead of US tech earnings, seen as a key test of the AI trade, and central bank meetings that could shape near-term interest-rate outlook.
items.body:
European shares slipped on Tuesday, dragged down by banking stocks, after disappointing results from HSBC, while investors also turned cautious ahead of US tech earnings, seen as a key test of the AI trade, and central bank meetings that could shape near-term interest-rate outlook.
The STOXX 600 banking sector (.SX7P) slid 1.3%, with shares of Europe's largest lender (HSBA.L) down 7% after [USN:L2N46D02S TEXT:"missing revenue expectations"] for the July-September quarter due to slower growth at its wealth business, while pretax profit was in line with estimates.
The pan-European STOXX 600 (.STOXX) dipped 0.2%, while London's FTSE 100 index (.FTSE) declined 1%, largely as a result of the drop in HSBC shares.
"Banks have been the winners of the latest quarter before this one, reporting record results because of high volatility and because of AI financing," said Ipek Ozkardeskaya, a senior market analyst at Swissquote Bank.
"But right now, they are coming under pressure because we do see the interest rate rise, short-term yields rising more than long-term; that's basically eating into the income revenue," she added.
"But I still think that the banks are in a good position to outperform the other sectors, especially sectors that are more vulnerable to directly rising living costs."
Quarterly earnings are the central focus globally, as investors weigh up the impact of the conflict in Iran, including higher costs and interest rates, on corporate performance.
EARNINGS DELUGE In the US this week, more than a third of S&P 500 companies are expected to report and the scrutiny of AI hyperscalers including Microsoft (MSFT.O) , Amazon (AMZN.O) and Alphabet (GOOGL.O) will be intense, as investors seek signs that these companies' billion-dollar investments are yielding returns as expected.
"We remain medium-term bullish on the 'picks and shovels' trade. We see capex cycle remaining strong and the earnings remaining robust," Mohit Kumar, an economist at Jefferies, said.
"However, we do admit that, as with any cycle, there would be winners and losers in the AI trade and a number of companies will not remain profitable and even go bust."
Big Tech earnings could determine appetite for the eagerly awaited public debut of AI bellwether [USN:L6N46C148 TEXT:"Anthropic"] and Meta Platforms' (META.O) $95-billion equity fundraising.
Claude-owner Anthropic disclosed a steep loss, but red-hot revenue growth, in its filing for a US initial public offering on Monday and is expected to list before the end of November.
The enthusiasm around Anthropic lifted stocks in Asia and helped MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan (.MIAPJ0000PUS) rise 0.1%. Nasdaq futures were muted after strong gains in the previous session.
CENTRAL BANKS EXPECTED TO STAY ON HOLD Policy decisions from the [USN:L6N46518P TEXT:"Federal Reserve"], European Central Bank and [USN:L3N46C02N TEXT:"Bank of Japan"] are due later this week, with economists expecting all three to stand pat on interest rates, leaving the focus on comments from policymakers to gauge the rates outlook.
Fed [USN:L6N46518P TEXT:"policymakers"] have telegraphed they will not raise short-term borrowing costs again on Wednesday, but with inflation concerns still front and centre, investors believe a rate-hike pause will not last for long. Traders are pricing in a 25 basis point hike from the Fed in December, the CME Group's FedWatch Tool showed.
The euro eased 0.1% and at $1.115 it was near the May low it hit two weeks ago.

items.title: K-pop agency JYP shares soar after little-known groups announce tender offer
items.author: Hyunjoo Jin
items.creator: Hyunjoo Jin
items.summary: Shares of JYP Entertainment , home to K-pop groups TWICE and Stray Kids, jumped more than 10% on Tuesday after two little-known investor groups said they were preparing a tender offer for up to 50% of the company.
items.body:
Shares of JYP Entertainment (035900.KQ) , home to K-pop groups TWICE and Stray Kids, jumped more than 10% on Tuesday after two little-known investor groups said they were preparing a tender offer for up to 50% of the company.
NEXROC Group and SVCV Inc plan to launch a tender offer in November for a 25% to 50% stake in JYP at a 30% premium to a benchmark share price, the Japan- and China-based groups said in a statement.
JYP said it had not received a tender offer.
The Financial Supervisory Service (FSS), South Korea's financial watchdog, said in a statement on Tuesday that it was highly unusual to announce publicly an intention to launch a tender offer before filing a tender offer registration statement.
Noting JYP's share price had become more volatile since media reports of the plan, the FSS said it was closely watching for abnormal trading and rule violations, and would quickly open an investigation if it suspected unfair trading.
It also said that, without a filing, it was difficult to verify details of the bidder and its funding, and the deal might not go ahead. It urged investors to beware of losses from share price swings.
JYP has a current market value of about $1.06 billion, meaning a 50% stake would be worth about $530 million before factoring in the reported premium.
UNUSUAL MOVE While an acquisition would give the investors a stake in one of South Korea's leading K-pop agencies, whose roster also includes ITZY and DAY6, analysts questioned whether the groups had secured sufficient financing for such a significant transaction.
"A company has to launch a tender offer when they have enough financial backing/assets that would allow them to launch a tender offer," said Douglas Kim, an independent analyst who writes on investment research platform Smartkarma, adding that allowing such a pre-tender offer "could set a bad precedent in the Korean equity markets."
Data platform PitchBook lists the NEXROC Group as early-stage venture capital-funded in 2025, with a most recent funding round of $25 million.
NEXROC Group is evaluating 15 acquisition targets across multiple industries and geographies and aims to retain at least 51% equity ownership in its portfolio companies, according to its website.
The group aims to build $200 billion in assets under management within a decade.
"There are many doubts about what the company is," said Lee Nara, an analyst at Sangsangin Securities in Seoul.
JYP was founded by South Korean singer-songwriter and producer Park Jin-young, known as J.Y. Park. Park owns 15.4% of the company.
JYP shares, which rallied as much as 14%, trimmed earlier gains and closed up 6.8%.
($1 = 1,325.6500 won)

items.summary: Pakistani security forces have faced allegations of assaulting women and children, confiscating valuables and mistreating family members during separate raids on residential properties in Gomazi and ...
items.body:
Pakistani forces accused of abusing women, children during raids in Balochistan’s Kech district Pakistani security forces have faced allegations of assaulting women and children, confiscating valuables and mistreating family members during separate raids on residential properties in Gomazi and Sarnkan in Balochistan’s Kech district. The incidents have raised further concerns over alleged abuses during security operations in the region, as reported by The Balochistan Post.
ANI | Updated: 27-10-2026 13:17 IST | Created: 27-10-2026 13:17 IST

 Representative Image (File Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Pakistani security forces have faced allegations of assaulting women and children, confiscating valuables and mistreating family members during separate raids on residential properties in Gomazi and Sarnkan in Balochistan’s Kech district. The incidents have raised further concerns over alleged abuses during security operations in the region, as reported by The Balochistan Post. According to The Balochistan Post, security personnel conducted overnight raids on several houses in Gomazi, located in the Tump tehsil of Kech district. During the operation, women were allegedly subjected to physical assault, while residents claimed that personnel seized mobile phones and other valuable belongings.
No arrests or casualties were reported in connection with the raid. In a separate incident in Sarnkan, Pakistani forces reportedly raided and searched the family residence of Adnan Baloch and Adham Baloch, two brothers who have allegedly been forcibly disappeared. Sources claimed that women and children faced physical violence and mistreatment during questioning, while security personnel allegedly confiscated mobile phones from the household. Adham Baloch was allegedly taken from his residence during the night of October 19-20 by an armed group that local sources described as being backed by the state. His whereabouts have reportedly remained unknown since the incident.
His younger brother, Adnan Baloch, was detained by Pakistani security personnel at Heerabad Hotel on August 19, 2026. He has also remained missing since his reported detention, according to the sources. The two brothers are sons of Muhammad Ibrahim. Their family has reportedly faced repeated security-related incidents even before the brothers went missing, as highlighted by The Balochistan Post. Sources alleged that state personnel had targeted the family’s residence with hand grenades on three separate occasions before their disappearances. Pakistani authorities had not released an official statement addressing the alleged raids, claims of violence against family members or the reported enforced disappearances of Adnan and Adham Baloch, as reported by The Balochistan Post. (ANI)

items.title: HRCP slams Pakistan’s emergency rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, warns of growing assault on democracy
items.summary: The Human Rights Commission of Pakistan (HRCP) has reiterated its strong opposition to the imposition of emergency and governor’s rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, warning that the measures threaten ...
items.body:
HRCP slams Pakistan’s emergency rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, warns of growing assault on democracy The Human Rights Commission of Pakistan (HRCP) has reiterated its strong opposition to the imposition of emergency and governor’s rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, warning that the measures threaten democratic institutions, fundamental rights and political freedoms.
ANI | Updated: 27-10-2026 13:13 IST | Created: 27-10-2026 13:13 IST

Police guard a road leading to Red Zone, in Peshawar, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province, Pakistan (File Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

The Human Rights Commission of Pakistan (HRCP) has reiterated its strong opposition to the imposition of emergency and governor’s rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, warning that the measures threaten democratic institutions, fundamental rights and political freedoms. In a press release shared on X, HRCP raised concerns over the erosion of democratic space, arbitrary detentions, restrictions on political activity and the disproportionate impact of security operations on civilians.
The commission said the situation was particularly troubling because Khyber Pakhtunkhwa is Pakistan’s only opposition-led province. It described the detention of the province’s elected chief executive as a serious violation of democratic norms, while pointing to the arrests of elected representatives and political workers, including women affiliated with Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) in Punjab, as evidence of a broader crackdown. HRCP condemned militancy and terrorism but stressed that counterterrorism operations must comply with the law and should not be used to justify collective punishment, excessive force or violations of fundamental rights. It stated that military operations could result in civilian casualties and mass displacement, arguing that force alone cannot establish lasting peace.
The commission also expressed concern over preventive and unlawful detention, calling for detainees to be informed of the reasons for their arrest, granted access to lawyers and family members, and presented before courts within the legally prescribed timeframe. Despite the restoration of mobile and internet services following initial shutdowns, HRCP said the full impact of the disruptions remained unclear. It noted that connectivity restrictions affect access to information, education, communication and livelihoods.
Curfews and military deployments in North and South Waziristan, Bannu and Miranshah have also continued to disrupt civilian life, according to the commission, which urged authorities to disclose information about civilian casualties and provide assistance to displaced families. HRCP further flagged reports of police raids on PTI workers in Peshawar, Swat and Khyber, alongside the dispersal of public gatherings. (ANI)

NEW DELHI, Oct 27 : Oil prices turned positive on Tuesday after a fall of about 1 per cent, earlier in the session, as the chance of talks in Tehran eased fears of a broader Middle East supply shock, while renewed Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia highlighted persistent risks.
Brent crude futures was up 40 cents, or 0.4 per cent, at $116.24 a barrel by 0718 GMT, while US West Texas Intermediate crude was up 30 cents, or 0.3 per cent, at $102.07. Both fell 1 per cent earlier in the session.
Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan held talks with Iranian officials in Tehran on Monday aimed at easing tension in the Middle East.
The four countries agreed to continue talks with a view to strengthening cooperation in peace and security, Iranian state media said.
